description: Perennial herbs, roots thickened. Leaves alternate (rarely opposite or verticillate, not in Thailand). Inflorescences (Thailand): an elongated raceme-like panicle, comprising several short few-flowered cymes. Flowers regular; ovary inferior, 3-locular; sepals oblong or linear; corolla campanulate, lobes shorter than the tube; stamens free, filaments dilated at base, ciliate or glabrous; style as long as or longer than the corolla, at base surrounded by a disc, stigma 3-lobed. Fruit a capsule, opening with 3 pores or valves at base. Seeds ellipsoid, 1–1.5 mm long, 1-ribbed.</br></br>A genus of about 60 species distributed in Europe (few), India, Central Asia to Vietnam and Japan. One species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Perennial herb with woody rootstock; shoots 1 or 2, erect, simple, 50–100 cm tall; sparsely hairy, glabrescent. Leaves: radical leaves few; petiole 4–8 cm long, blades broadly-elliptic or subcircular, 2–6 cm long; cauline leaves alternate, sessile; blades hairy, especially along veins on both surfaces, ovate-elliptic, 4–6(–9) by 1.5–4 cm, acute(-acuminate), serrate. Inflorescence a narrow panicle or a pseudoraceme, 15–30 cm long, 10–20-flowered. Flowers: ovary obconical, ca 3 by 3 mm, glabrous; sepals linear, 5–7 mm long, at base 1–1.5 mm wide, margin at each side with 1–4 teeth; corolla blue, glabrous, campanulate, ca 20 mm long, including 7 mm long acute lobes; filaments 2–3 mm long; disc nectariferous, tube-shaped, short, ca 1 mm long; style slightly exserted, stigma lobed to ca halfway deep, thelobes ultimately recurved. Capsule (not known from Thailand) broadly ellipsoid, somewhat narrowed towards apex, ca 8 by 6 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Annual (or biennial), mostly erect herbs of open wet places, glabrous (calyx glabrous or hairy), branches ± quadrangular. Leaves decussate, sessile, 1-nerved. Inflorescences dichasial, (1–)3–many-flowered, sessile or peduncled; bracteoles 2, minute. Flowers actinomorphic, 4(–6)-merous, calyx tube campanulate or urceolate, 4–8-nerved, epicalyx-like appendages obvious, or minute or absent, calyx lobes (sepals) short; petals absent or small, fugacious; stamens 4(–8), inserted in the lower half of the calyx tube, episepalous, included or exserted; ovary incompletely (1–)2–4(–5)-locular, placentas axile (but because of thin incomplete septa in fruit appearing central); style shorter or longer than ovary; disc absent. Capsules (sub)globose, thin-walled, not transversely striate, irregularly transversely rupturing. Seeds numerous, concave-convex, angular, 0.3–0.5 mm long.</br></br>About 25 species worldwide. Seven species in Asia, 2 species, of which one common in Thailand. Some more species are to be expected in Thailand, to be found in paddy fields or in soggy places, but these have not yet been collected, e.g. Ammannia coccinea Rottb. and A. octandra L.f.

description: Erect, annual herbs 25–60 cm tall, much branched in upper part; branches 4-angular, not winged. Leaves sessile; lamina narrowly elliptic or lanceolate, (0.5–)1.5–8 by 0.2–0.8(–1.2) cm, base broadened, broadly rounded or shallowly cordate, apex acute. Inflorescences 3–15-flowered cymes; peduncle (0.1–)0.5(–1.8) cm long. Flowers 4-merous; pedicel 0.5–3(–6) mm long; bracteoles minute; calyx tube glabrous, campanulate, 1–1.5 mm long, 4- or 8-ribbed, calyx lobes ca 0.3 mm long, calyx appendages minute or absent; petals pink or red, spreading, obovate, ca 1 mm long, margin (sub)entire, fugaceous; stamens 4(–8, not in Thailand), ca 1.5 mm long, exserted; ovary broadly ellipsoid, ca 1 mm diam., style red, as long as or longer than the ovary. Capsules purple, subglobose, 1.5–2 mm diam., exceeding the calyx lobes by ca ¼. Seeds brown, ca 0.3 mm long.

description: Erect, annual herbs 10–40(–150) cm tall, branched, sometimes basal branches ascending; branches ± 4-angular, not winged. Leaves (sometimes alternate), sessile; lamina narrowly elliptic or oblanceolate, 1–7 by 0.2–0.8(–1.5) cm, narrowed towards the base (broad at base in var. aegyptiaca (Willd.) Koehne, Africa), apex (sub)acute. Inflorescences (1–)3–many-flowered thyrses; peduncle 0.1(–0.2) cm long. Flowers greenish, 4-merous; pedicel 1(–2) mm long; bracteoles minute; calyx tube glabrous, narrowly campanulate, 1–1.5 mm long, 8-ribbed, calyx lobes purplish at apex, ca 0.5 mm long; calyx appendages (almost) absent; petals absent; stamens 4, inserted about halfway up the calyx tube, not (or hardly) exserted; ovary (depressed) globose; style short, to 0.3 mm long. Capsules covered for (over) halfway by the persistent calyx, (depressed) globose, 1(–2) mm diam. Seeds red, ca 0.3 mm diam.

description: Perennial herbs; root somewhat carrot-shaped. Leaves alternate. Inflorescences elongate, spike- or raceme-like, comprising several axillary short cymes, each composed of (1 or) 2–4 flowers; bracts present; pedicel short, with 2 bracteoles at base. Flowers regular; ovary inferior, 3-locular; sepals linear; corolla lobes almost free, linear; filaments dilated at base, margin densely ciliate; style nearly as long as the corolla, hairy towards the apex, stigma 3-lobed, segments linear, recurved. Fruit a capsule, 9- or 10-ribbed, opening with 3 pores above the middle. Seeds ovoid, ellipsoid or oblong, sometimes angular, 0.5–1 mm long.</br></br>A genus of 33 species distributed in Europe, N Africa, and temperate Asia. One species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Stem single, simple, erect, 30–100 cm tall, usually unbranched, rarely branched in response to damage, usually glabrous, sometimes sparsely hairy towards the base. Leaves all nearly sessile, but radical leaves subcordate with petiole 3(–10) cm long; blades glabrous or sparsely hairy above, usually glabrous beneath, sometimes sparsely hairy along the veins, ovate, lanceolate or elliptic, 3.5–7 by 1–4 cm, base cuneate, margin serrate-dentate, apex acute-acuminate. Inflorescences composed of distant, few-flowered cymose clusters; bracts small, narrow. Flowers bluish purple; ovary subglobose or obovoid, ca 4 mm diam.; sepals glabrous, linear, (5–)10 mm long; corolla lobes equal to sepals in length or slightly longer; filaments much widened towards base, ciliate, anthers ca 6 mm long; style shorter than the corolla. Capsule subglobose, ca 5 mm diam., distinctly 9–10-ribbed.

description: Herbs or subshrubs, erect or prostrate, richly branched. Leaves opposite, margin serrulate, petiolate. Flowers very small, numerous, arranged in axillary cymes or clustered in leaf-axils, rarely solitary; sepals 5, free, with conspicuous midribs, leathery, margin membranous, apex long acuminate; petals as many as sepals, free, membranous; stamens as many as or more than petals, but not twice as many. Ovary ovoid-orbicular or subglobose, apex somewhat acute, 5-locular with many ovules; styles short; stigmas capitate. Capsule hard, almost bony, 5-septicidal. Seeds numerous, oblong, slightly curved, reticulate with elliptic or hexagonal pits.</br></br>About 25 species: tropical and warm temperate regions; one species known in Thailand and another one expected.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Annual herbs, 15–30 cm tall. Stem glabrous, slightly fleshy, terete, prostrate and rooting in lower part; branches erect. Leaves opposite, papery, elliptic-lanceolate, obovate-lanceolate or obovate, 1–4 by 0.2–1 cm, apex acute or attenuate, base acuminate, margin minutely serrulate or subentire; petioles 1–5 mm long, compressed-flat; stipules ovate-triangular, membranous, dentate-sinuate. Flowers very small, pink, subsessile or with short pedicels 1–5 mm long, arranged into small axillary cymes; sepals 5, erect, narrowly lanceolate, ca 1–2 mm long; petals 5, oblong or subspathulate, slightly exceeding or subequalling sepals; stamens 10, free; filaments filiform, base rather broad. Ovary subglobose; styles straight or curved. Capsule subglobose, ca 1.8 mm diam., longitudinally 5-grooved, 5-septicidal. Seeds numerous, minute, oblong, angular or transversely striate, with 4-5 rows of hexagonal pits.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Perennial (or annual, not in Thailand) herbs, with woody rootstock. Leaves alternate. Inflorescences: flowers solitary and terminal or in cymes or (raceme-like) panicles; bracteoles absent. Flowers regular; sepals (narrowly) triangular, persistent, inserted at apex of ovary; corolla campanulate, lobed to less than halfway; stamens free, filaments dilated at base, anthers at first coherent (or connate, not in Thailand); disc absent; ovary inferior, 3(–5)-locular, stigmas 3(–5). Fruit a capsule, dehiscent by few lateral pores or valves below the withered perianth. Seeds ellipsoid, ca 0.4 mm long, smooth.</br></br>A genus of about 400 species, circumboreal in distribution. Three species in Thailand.</br></br>The species descriptions are largely based on Thai material and may, therefore, not apply outside this country.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Perennial herb, 15–30 cm tall, densely grey-villous, with several or many (caespitose) slender ascending branches from apex of woody root. Leaves: approximate, petiole to 0.5 cm long or absent; basal blades ± spathulate, cauline blades broadly elliptic, 1–2(–2.5) by 0.5–1(–1.5) cm, base cuneate, margin shallowly dentate or crenulate, or serrate, apex obtuse or short-acute. Inflorescences a few-flowered terminal or axillary short cyme or raceme, or flowers solitary; bracts elliptic, ca 0.5 cm long. Flowers patent; pedicel to 5 mm long, sometimes with bract apically (in supposedly cleistogamous flower pedicel to 20 mm long); ovary obconical, ca 2 mm long; sepals ovate-triangular, 2(–3) mm long, margin (subentire or) coarsely dentate, apex acute; corolla blue, 6–10 mm long, tube broadly campanulate, 3–5 mm long, lobes (sparsely) hairy, 3–4 mm long; filaments 1.5–2 mm long, at base broadened, ciliate, anthers 1.5–2 mm long; style included, ca 4 mm long, stigma lobes 1.5–2 mm long. Capsule hairy, subglobose-obconical, ca 5 mm long, (faintly) 5-ribbed, opening by 3 pores at base; persistent sepals toothed, ca 5 mm long. Seeds compressed, light brown, shiny, smooth.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Perennial herb, 20–40 cm tall, with root woody at base, whole plant (sparsely) hairy; main branch(es) single or few, suberect or ascending. Cauline leaves: petiole to 0.2 cm long, winged, or petiole absent; blade elliptic, 1–3 by 0.5–1(–1.5) cm, base cuneate, margin coarsely dentate, apex acute. Inflorescences loose, terminal, few-flowered cymes, or flowers solitary, terminal or axillary; bracts ovate-oblong, ca 0.5 cm long. Flowers ± pendent; pedicel 5–10(–20) mm long, sometimes with a bract at apex; ovary hispid, obconical, ca 3 mm long; sepals triangular, ca 4 mm long, margin subentire or coarsely dentate, apex acute; corolla deep blue or dark violet, ca 10 mm long, tube ca 6 mm long, lobes sparsely hairy, ca 4 mm long, apex acute; filaments 2–3 mm long, anthers ca 2 mm long; style included, ca 6 mm long, stigma lobes linear. Capsule hairy on main veins, short-obconical or globose, ca 5 mm diam., 5-ribbed, opening by 3 pores at base. Seeds light brown, shiny, compressed, narrowly ellipsoid.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Perennial herb, 15–50 cm tall, with root woody towards base, carrying 1–6 woody suberect or ascending simple or branched main branches 1.5–4 mm thick, lasting several years; lower portions of older plants commonly with withered leaves or leaf-scars only, whole plant densely appressed grey-hairy. Cauline leaves densely set; petiole absent; blades subcoriaceous, oblong or linear-lanceolate, 1.5–3.5 by 0.1–0.3 cm, base attenuate, margin obscurely undulate and recurved over the grey-white lower surface, apex subobtuse. Inflorescences: panicles composed of 1–3 few-flowered cyme-like monochasia in axils of upper leaves; peduncle 1–3 cm long; bracts 0.1–0.3(–0.5) cm long. Flowers patent; pedicel 5–10 mm long; ovary densely fine-hairy, obconical, 2(–3) mm long; sepals (narrowly triangular-)lanceolate, 2–3 mm long, margin revolute, apex acute; corolla (pale) blue, 7–8 mm long, tube 4(–5) mm long, lobes minutely grey-hairy outside, ca 3 mm long, subacute; filaments dilated at base, (1–)1.5 mm long, anthers linear, (1.5–)2–3 mm long; style hairy, (2–)3–5 mm long; stigma lobes ca 1 mm long, recurved. Capsule obconical, 2.5–4 by 3–4 mm, opening with 3 valves at base. Seeds compressed, yellow or brown, shiny, narrowly ellipsoid.

description: Climber 1–3 m tall, tuberous root 5–10(–20) cm long (Fig. 7A); stem glabrous or glabrescent, smooth, 1–2 mm diam. Leaves mostly (sub)opposite; petiole 1.5–6.5 cm long; blade glabrous or (sparsely or densely) hairy beneath, (narrowly) ovate, 2.5–8 by 2–5 cm, base cordate, margin subentire or coarsely serrate, apex obtuse or acute. Flowers subaxillary, glabrous; pedicel 10–50 mm long; ovary depressed globose, 3-locular, 6–10 mm diam.; sepals free from ovary, valvate in bud, oblong-ovate or narrowly triangular, 10–20 mm long, (sub)entire; corolla outside cream, inside cream marked with purple and green, (15–)20–35 mm long, divided nearly to halfway, lobes broadly triangular, 10–15 mm long; style 8–12 mm long, stigma 3-lobed; filaments terete, ca 10 mm long, anthers 4–5 mm long. Berry ripening purple, globose, with flattish apex, 10–25 mm diam. Seeds subglobose, ca 0.5 mm diam.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Trees; branchlets pubescent. Leaves alternate and distichous, scattered; lamina chartaceous to subcoriaceous, elliptic, obovate, lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate; apex obtusely acuminate; base broadly cuneate, shortly decurrent, glabrous or pubescent; secondary venation looped; midrib grooved or flat above, prominent below; secondary veins variable in number; tertiary veins parallel-reticulate to the secondary veins; stipules absent. Flowers bisexual, fascicled either in axils of leaves or fallen leaves. Calyx a single whorl of 5 (–6) quincuncial sepals. Corolla campanulate; tube shorter to longer than the lobes; lobes 5 (–6). Stamens 5 (–6), inserted in the corolla tube; anthers extrorse, hairy or glabrous; staminodes absent. Disc absent. Ovary 9–11-locular. Fruits 1–many-seeded. Seed laterally compressed.</br></br>About 70 species occuring in the Neotropics, Africa, Madagascar and extending to Australia. One indigenous and one cultivated in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Chrysophyllum  . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 11. Part 4, 2014. Pg. 611. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Tree to 8 m tall; branchlets terete, light brown to reddish brown sericeous. Leaves scattered; lamina chartaceous or subcoriaceous, broadly elliptic, obovate or oblong; 6–12 by 3.3–6.2 cm; apex obtusely acuminate, somewhat emarginate; base broadly cuneate, shortly decurrent; both surfaces reddish brown sericeous, very quickly glabrescent above, becoming glossy, turning dark reddish brown sericeous below, ultimately brown coloured; midrib grooved above, sparsely hairy, very prominent below, with sparse hairs; secondary veins 13–17 on each side; tertiary veins inconspicuous on both surfaces; petioles 8–20 mm long, grooved above, reddish brown sericeous or brownish. Inflorescence 5–20-flowered; pedicels angular, 5–10 mm long, reddish brown to brownish sericeous. Calyx lobes 5 (–6), more or less orbicular 1–1.2 by 1.1–1.3 mm. Corolla 2.5–3.6 mm long; tube 1.3–1.8 mm long; lobes 5 (–6), triangular or deltoid, 1.3–1.8 by 1.3–1.7 mm, sericeous along mid-line outside, glabrous inside. Stamens 5 (–6); filaments 0.3–0.4 mm long, deltoid; anthers ovoid, 0.6–0.8 mm long; connective filiform. Ovary 9–11-locular, reddish brown tomentose; style 0.3–0.4 mm long, glabrous; stigma 10-lobed. Fruits obovoid-globose, to 5.5 by 4 cm, glabrous.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Chrysophyllum cainito . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 11. Part 4, 2014. Pg. 611. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Tree to 25 m tall; branchlets terete, reddish brown tomentose or glabrescent. Leaves scattered; lamina chartaceous, lanceolate, oblong-lanceolate or ovate, 6.8–10 by 2.3–3.5 cm; apex obtusely acuminate; base broadly cuneate, slightly asymmetrical; both surfaces reddish brown tomentose, quickly glabrescent; upper surface glossy; lower surface slightly glossy to glossy; midrib raised, sparsely hairy; secondary veins 18–27 on each side; tertiary veins inconspicuous above, more prominent below; petioles 3–4 mm long, reddish brown tomentose. Inflorescence 10–25-flowered; pedicels 3–5 mm long, sparsely hairy, glabrescent. Calyx 5-lobed, ovate or more or less orbicular, 0.7–1.2 by 0.6–1 mm, reddish brown tomentose outside, glabrous inside. Corolla 1.8–2.1 mm long, glabrous; tube 0.7–1.2 mm long; lobes 5, ligulateto trapezoid, 1 by 1–1.5 mm. Stamens 5, 0.9–1.5 mm long; filaments 0.5–1 mm long; anthers ovoid, ca 0.8 mm long; connective rectangular to acute, fimbriate. Ovary subglobose, 5-locular, 5-ribbed, reddish brown tomentose; style 1.5 mm long, glabrous; stigma minute. Fruits globular, 5-winged, 1.5–4 by 1.5–4 cm, reddish brown tomentose when young, glabrescent.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Herbs, perennial, rhizomatous, often forming large colonies. Leaves petiolate, opposite, becoming alternate and bract-like in inflorescence. Inflorescences racemes, sometimes branched at base, terminal on main stem and at apex of short axillary branches. Flowers 2-merous, with a floral tube; sepals and petals alternate; petals obcordate or obtrullate, apex notched, white or pink; stamens opposite sepals, anthers white or pink, pollen in monads, white; nectary wholly within floral tube or elongated and projecting above opening of floral tube as a fleshy cylindrical or ring-like disk; ovary locules 1 or 2, ovules 1 per locule, style equalling or longer than stamens, stigma 2-lobed. Fruit an indehiscent capsule, with stiff uncinate hairs, with or without conspicuous rows of corky tissue. Seeds fusiform or broadly clavoid to narrowly ovoid, smooth, adhering ± firmly to inner ovary. 2n = 22.</br></br>Eight species: temperate and boreal forests of the N hemisphere, from near sea level to 5000 m altitude and from 10°–70° N; one species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Plants 3.5–45 cm tall; stem densely to sparsely pubescent. Leaves ovate to broadly ovate, less commonly orbicular-ovate, 2–7 by 1.4–4.5 cm, base truncate or rounded, less often broadly cuneate to subcordate, margin subentire to occasionally prominently dentate, apex acute to short acuminate. Inflorescence simple or branched, pubescent with short glandular hairs, less commonly glabrous; flowering pedicel erect or ascending, glabrous. Flowers clustered at apex of raceme and opening before elongation of raceme axis, with a minute setaceous bracteole at base; buds glabrous, rarely glabrescent, ovary with uncinate hairs at anthesis, floral tube nearly absent to 0.3 mm, nectary wholly within and at base of floral tube; sepals oblong to ovate, apex rounded to obtuse; petals narrowly to broadly obovate in outline, apical notch ¼–½ length of petal, petal lobes rounded; ovary unilocular, ovule 1, style equalling stamens. Fruit without corky tissue, with stiff uncinate hairs, hairs without pigment. Seed 1. Fl Jul–Sep(–Oct), fr Aug–Nov. 2n = 22.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Perennial herbs, stem twining (or erect, not in Thailand), inodorous (or foetid, not in Thailand), tuberous. Leaves alternate (or subopposite, not in Thailand). Flowers regular, solitary, terminal, pedicellate; sepals persistent, inserted (on or) at apex of ovary; corolla blue (or greenish, not in Thailand), rotate, deeply divided nearly to the base (or more shallowly lobed, not in Thailand); stamens free, filaments much widened at base; ovary inferior, 3-locular, stigma 3-lobed. Fruit a capsule, opening with valves at apex. Seeds compressed, ellipsoid (sometimes winged, not in Thailand).</br></br>A genus of about 40 species distributed in C, E and S Asia. One species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Twiner 0.5–1 m tall, inodorous, glabrous; stem single or few, 1–2 mm diam.; tuber ovoid or subglobose, to 5 cm diam. Leaves evenly distributed along the stem; petiole to 0.3 cm long; blade papery, elliptic or linear-lanceolate, 2–4(–7) by 0.5–1.5 cm, base rounded, margin entire, apex acute. Flowers terminal on main stem and side branches; pedicel 20–100(–200) mm long; bracteoles absent; ovary obconical, 5–7 by 5–8 mm, faintly 10-ribbed; sepals oblong or long-triangular, 6–10 mm long, at base 2–3 mm wide, margin entire, apex acute; corolla bright purple-blue, nearly rotate, 5-parted nearly to the base, 30–40(–50) mm diam., corolla lobes elliptic-oblong 20–25 by ca 10 mm, margin entire, apex (sub)acute; filaments 1.5–2 mm long, widened towards the base where densely white-hairy inside and ± clasping the short conical superior part of the ovary, upper portion of filaments glabrous, spreading, slender, ca 1 mm long; anthers linear, 2.5–3 mm long; style ca 3 mm long; stigma 3-lobed. Capsule obconical-obovoid, 10–14 by 6–11 mm, opening by three ca 4 mm long valves. Seeds ± compressed, broadly ellipsoid, ca 1 mm long.

description: Herbs or subshrubs, annual or perennial, glabrous or (glandular) hairy; branches terete or (sub)angular. Leaves decussate (or whorled), rarely alternate. Inflorescences racemose with single flowers decussate or alternate, beside the leaves (bracts) because of concaulescence; bracteoles 2 or absent. Flowers zygomorphous, 6-merous; calyx tube elongate, at base with (shallow) spur at one side; calyx appendages present or absent; calyx lobes (sepals) short; petals small or large, equal or unequal, persistent or caducous; stamens (4–)11, inserted in upper part of the calyx tube, included or exserted; ovary sessile, incompletely 2-locular, with disc-appendage at base; ovules few or numerous. Fruit a dehiscent capsule enclosed in the calyx tube. Seeds lentiform, sometimes with winged margin.</br></br>About 260 species in Tropical America; 1 species in Thailand, commonly cultivated, locally escaped and possibly naturalised.

description: Shrub-like, much branched, somewhat woody herbs 10–50 cm tall, sparsely finely (appressed) hairy. Leaves decussate, subsessile; lamina (ob)lanceolate, 1–2.5 cm long, apex (sub)obtuse or acute. Flowers solitary; pedicel ca 5 mm long; calyx tube glabrous, 5–6(–8) mm long; calyx lobes minute; petals lilac-blue (rarely white), inserted at the calyx throat, spreading, obovate, ca 4 mm long; stamens ca 11, included. Capsule about as long as the calyx tube, included. Seeds about 6, lentiform, ca 1.5 mm long.

description: Erect shrub-like herb 50–150 cm tall with a short woody rootstock, glabrous (except for lower leaf surface). Leaves: petiole 0.4–0.5 cm long; blade narrowly ovate-elliptic, (2.5–)3.5–9 by (0.5–)1.5–2.5 cm, base rounded or cuneate, margin finely or coarsely toothed, apex acute-acuminate. Inflorescences few-flowered terminal panicles, 5–10 cm across; bracts as much-reduced leaves; bracteoles linear, small. Flowers 5-merous; pedicel 10–60 mm long; ovary 2–3 mm long; sepals inserted on the ovary at or to below halfway above its base, in fruit inserted on the fruit above its base, patent, linear, 2.5–4 mm long, margin entire or sparsely serrate-dentate; corolla white, sometimes pale blue, 10–12 mm long, lobes triangular, ca 5 mm long; filaments glabrous, (sub)terete, ca 2.5 mm long; style ca 2.5 mm long, stigma 5-lobed, lobes oblong, ca 2 mm long. Berry green, ripening white, 5-celled, depressed globose, 6–8 by 8–14 mm (when fresh 8–10 by 12–16 mm). Seeds light brown, subglobose, ca 0.5 mm diam.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Erect herb 50–100 cm tall with a short woody rootstock, glabrous. Leaves: petiole 0.4–0.5 cm long; blade 7–12.5 by 1.5–3(–4) cm, base rounded or cuneate, margin finely serrate, apex long acute-acuminate. Inflorescences few-flowered terminal panicles, 5–10 cm across; bracts and bracteoles minute. Flowers 4-merous; pedicel 10–60 mm long; ovary ca 3 mm long; sepals inserted on the pedicel at base of the ovary or to 4 mm below the ovary; in fruit inserted at the base of the fruit or below, reflexed, linear, 3–6 mm long, margin entire or sparsely dentate-lacerate; corolla white, ca 5 mm long, lobes triangular, ca 2 mm long; filaments glabrous, terete, only slightly broadened at base, ca 2.5 mm long, anthers ca 2 mm long; style ca 2 mm long, stigma 4-lobed. Fruit green, ripening white, somewhat pinkish tinged, 4-celled, (depressed)globose or obovoid, 5–7 by 5–6 mm. Seeds light brown, subglobose, ca 0.5 mm diam.

description: Trees; branchlets pubescent, glabrescent. Leaves spiral, tufted at the ends of branchlets; lamina chartaceous, elliptic or obovate; apex acuminate or obtusely acuminate; base narrowly cuneate, glabrous; venation arched, somewhat looped; midrib grooved above, rounded below; secondary veins variable in number; tertiary veins transverse and reticulately connected; stipules present. Flowers bisexual or unisexual, ramiflorous; pedicels 2–2.5 cm long, pubescent. Calyx a single whorl or 5 free, of partly united quincuncial sepals. Corolla glabrous; lobes exceeding the corolla tube. Stamens (10–) 16–30 (–80); staminodes 26–28. Ovary conoid, 9–10-locular, pubescent; style exserted with minute stigmatic lobes. Fruits 1–2-seeded.</br></br>A genus with about 10 species in tropical Asia. One endemic species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Tree ca 10 m tall; branchlets stout, reddish brown sericeous. Leaves: lamina (29–) 45–66 by (8–) 13–18.5 cm, both surfaces glabrous; secondary veins 16–19 on each side, vanishing near the margin, somewhat looped in apical part of leaf; tertiary veins conspicuous on both surfaces; petioles 8–15 mm long, grooved above, rounded below, thickened in the basal part, glabrous; stipules unknown. Flowers in 4–10-flowered clusters on distinct, prominent warts; pedicels 2–2.5 cm long, reddish brown sericeous. Sepals lanceolate or ovate, 6–7.5 by 4–5 mm, reddish brown sericeous except for glabrous central and basal parts inside. Corolla 10 mm long; tube 4 mm long; lobes 14, obovate or oblong, 6–7 by 2–2.5 mm. Stamens not seen; staminodes 26–28, spathulate or oblong, 5–6 by 0.5–1 mm, woolly at base. Ovary reddish brown hirsute; style angular, 1.2–1.4 cm long, sparsely hirsute at base; stigma 9-lobed. Fruits ovoid or ellipsoid, 3.5–4 by 2–2.7 cm, crowned by a remnant of the style at apex, pericarp puberulous; sepals in fruit ovate, ca 7 by 4 mm, reddish brown sericeous outside, glabrous or reddish brown sericeous near apex inside; inner sepals with membranous, glabrous, fimbriate margins; pedicels in fruit stout, ca 3 cm long, sericeous, glabrescent.

description: Aquatic herbs; stem slender, prostrate, rooting at nodes. Leaves small, opposite, margin usually entire, shortly petiolate. Flowers very small, axillary, usually with only 1 flower at each node; sepals 2–4, base united, membranous, obtuse-acute; petals 2–4, longer than sepals, obtuse; stamens as many as or twice as many as petals. Ovary globose, compressed, apex truncate, 2–4-locular; ovules numerous; styles 2–4; stigmas capitate. Capsule membranous, 2–4-septicidal. Seeds numerous, straight, curved or hippocrepiform, angular and reticulate-striate, the surface with hexagonal or elliptical pits.</br></br>About 25 species: tropical, subtropical, and temperate regions; one species known in Thailand and another one expected.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Annual herbs, small, 1.5–3 cm tall. Stem prostrate, richly branched, rooting at nodes. Leaves spathulate, ovate-lanceolate to lanceolate or elliptic, 2–5 by 0.7 mm, apex obtuse-acute, margin entire, subsessile or shortly petiolate; petioles 1 mm long; stipules small, ca 1 mm long, membranous, lanceolate, apex acute, margin dentate. Flowers axillary, solitary; pedicels conspicuous, 1.5–2.5 mm long, curved downward at fruiting stage; calyx 3-fid; lobes oblong-ovate or widely lanceolate, 0.5 by 0.3 mm, apex obtuse, shorter than petals; petals 3, narrowly elliptic, elliptic or ovate, 1–1.5 by 0.5 mm, reddish, 2–3 times as long as sepals; stamens 3, shorter than petals. Ovary obovoid, 3-locular; styles 3. Capsule oblong-ovoid, 3-locular, 3-septicidal. Seeds numerous, ca 0.5 mm long, nearly straight or slightlycurved, reticulate-striate, with hexagonal pits.

description: Annual herbs, dwarf, weak. Stem 2–10 cm tall, prostrate, terete, richly branched, rooting at nodes; internodes short. Leaves opposite, submembranous, ovate-oblong, lanceolate to linear-lanceolate, 3–10 by 1.5–3 mm, apex obtuse, base attenuate, margin entire, glabrous on adaxial side, sessile or shortly petiolate; petioles 0.5–3 mm long; lateral veins minute, 2–3-paired; stipules small, membranous, triangular or ovate-lanceolate, 0.7–1 mm long, apex acute, caducous. Flowers axillary, solitary, sessile or subsessile, or shortly pedicellate; pedicels 0.3–0.4 mm long at fruiting stage; sepals 2–3, ovate, 0.5(–0.7) mm long, apex obtuse, base united; petals 3, white or reddish, broadly ovate or elliptic, slightly longer than sepals; stamens 3, shorter than petals; ovary compressed-globose, 3-locular; styles 3, free, short, erect. Capsule compressed-globose, 1–1.5 mm diam., 3-locular, 3-septicidal. Seeds numerous, oblong, ca 0.5 mm long, nearly erect or slightly curved, with hexagonal pits.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Herbs, perennial or annual, sometimes suffrutescent, with basal leafy rosettes, stolons, soboles (shoots), or turions (subterranean globose buds with fleshy scales); stems glabrous or pubescent, often with raised lines of hairs decurrent from margins of petioles. Leaves opposite, becoming alternate and bract-like in inflorescence; petiolate or sessile; stipules absent; bracteoles absent. Inflorescences simple or branched racemes, panicles, spikes, or corymbs. Flowers 4-merous, often protandrous, with floral tube, producing nectar at base of style; sepals green or reddish green; petals obcordate or obtrullate, notched at apex, pink, rose-purple or white [rarely cream coloured or orange-red]; stamens 8, in two unequal whorls; pollen yellow, shed in tetrads; style erect, stigma entire or 4-lobed. Fruit an elongate, slender capsule, 4-locular, loculidical. Seeds many [rarely only 4], with terminal coma of silky hairs [coma rarely lacking]. 2n = 18, 20, 24, 26, 28, 30, 32, 36, 38, 60.</br></br>About 165 species: montane, boreal, and/or arctic regions of North and South America, Asia, Europe, Africa, and Australasia, from sea level to 5000 m, often in moist, disturbed places; 2 species in Thailand.</br></br>The genus is divided into seven sections; only Epilobium sect. Epilobium, in Thailand.</br></br>Careful gathering of ripe seeds and perennating structures, usually at or just below the ground surface, facilitate identification. The pattern of vestiture on stems, also extremely valuable for identification, is sometimes obscure on specimens collected very late in the growing season.

description: Herbs, perennial, erect or ascending, with fleshy soboles that leave loose brown basal scales; stems 15–90 cm tall, simple to well-branched, strigillose throughout, sometimes mixed with glandular hairs on inflorescence, lacking raised lines decurrent from petioles. Leaves subcoriaceous, lanceolate or elliptic to narrowly ovate, 1.5–5(–8) by 0.5–2.2(–3) cm, subglabrous with strigillose margin and midvein, base subcordate to cuneate, apex subobtuse to acute, margin sharply denticulate with 7–22 teeth on each side; lateral veins prominent beneath, 5–6 per side; petiole 0–4 mm. Inflorescence erect to slightly nodding. Flower sepals 4.5–6.5 mm, keeled; petals 7–11 mm, pink to rose-purple; stigma entire, clavate. Capsules 3.5–7 cm, strigillose and often glandular; pedicels 0.4–1.5 cm. Seeds 1–1.1 mm, dark brown, coarsely papillose, with short chalazal collar; coma white, detaching easily. Fl. Jul–Sep(–Oct), fr. Sep–Oct. 2n = 36.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Herbs perennial, robust, erect, with fleshy stolons 1–12 cm, extending underground and terminating in thickened buds. Stems 40–120(–200) cm tall, simple or sparsely branched, densely glandular and strigillose throughout, with faint raised strigillose lines decurrent from margins of petioles. Leaves subsessile above, lower ones with petioles 1–6 mm; cauline blade narrowly ovate to lanceolate, 3.5–8(–11) × 1.5–4(–4.5) cm, subglabrous with densely strigillose margin and midvein, base broadly cuneate to subrounded, margin sharply serrulate with 28–42(–60) teeth per side, apex acute. Inflorescence erect, congested; flowers erect. Sepals 5–8 mm. Petals rose-purple, 7–15(–18) mm. Stigma capitate to broadly clavate, entire. Capsules 7–11 cm, strigillose, glandular; pedicels 0.7–1.5 cm. Seeds dark brown, 0.8–1.2 mm, coarsely papillose, with short chalazal collar; coma white, detaching easily.

description: Perennial herb; stems (sub)erect. Leaves alternate. Inflorescences consisting of solitary, axillary flowers. Flowers large, fragrant, almost regular, pedicellate; bracteoles filiform, at base of pedicel; ovary inferior, 2-locular, stigma 2-lobed; sepals persistent; corolla salverform, tube long, slender, lobes spreading; stamens inserted in the corolla tube above the middle; anthers united into a tube, hairy at apex. Fruit a capsule, opening with 2 valves at apex. Seeds numerous, somewhat flattened, very small.</br></br>Monotypic.

description: Erect herb 9–35(–50) cm tall, glabrous or hairy at apex. Leaves: petiole absent; blade glabrous or sparsely hairy, oblanceolate or elliptic, 7–16 by 1–3.7 cm, base attenuate, margin coarsely and mostly deeply serrate, apex acute-acuminate. Flowers solitary, fragrant; pedicel densely hairy, 3–10 mm long; bracteoles up to 5 mm long; ovary densely hairy, 2-locular, obconic or ellipsoid, 6–9 mm long; sepals hairy, linear, 8–20 mm long, margin denticulate; corolla white, tube hairy, 65–100 mm long, lobes (narrowly) elliptic or linear, 18–25 mm long; anthers connate, all hairy at apex, forming a tube ca 7 mm long; style ca 7 mm long, stigma 2-lobed. Capsule pendent, densely hairy, broadly ellipsoid, or obconic, 11–15 by 8–12 mm. Seeds light brown, 0.7–1 mm long.

description: Shrubs or trees. Young twigs terete or 4-angled, glabrous or hairy, often glabrescent. Leaves (sub)opposite, decussate, or alternate (distichous), subsessile or petiolate; stipules absent or rudimentary. Inflorescences terminal or axillary, paniculate (or raceme-like), lateral branches cymose; bracts small, caducous. Flowers often showy, glabrous or hairy, 5–7(–9)-merous, actinomorphic (see note); calyx tube campanulate or turbinate, leathery, smooth or with broad or narrow ribs or ridges, at base gradually or ± abruptly narrowed into a shorter or longer stipe (pseudopedicel); calyx lobes (sepals) 6–9, (long-)triangular, sometimes subtended within by a line-shaped annulus; epicalyx appendages (auricles) alternating with calyx lobes, small or prominent, or absent; petals 6–9, pink, purple or white, narrowly clawed; stamens 15–100 or more, inserted inside at halfway or near base of calyx tube, exserted, dimorphic in most species: 6(–11) solitary in front of calyx lobes with thick filaments and larger anthers, the rest in clusters in front of petals with thin filaments and small anthers, rarely monomorphic, then all filaments thin, subequal; ovary sessile, (largely) free from calyx tube, globose or ellipsoid, 3–6 locular; style long-exserted; stigma small, capitate. Fruit a dry, hard capsule, at base more or less adnate to the base of the calyx tube, calyx tube including calyx lobes persistent, globose or ellipsoid, glabrous or (partially) hairy, loculicidally dehiscent, 4–6-valved, apex rounded or pointed. Seeds numerous, flattish, obpyramidal, with wing from raphe; cotyledons convolute.</br></br>About 55 species: tropical and subtropical Asia to Australia, north to Japan; 18 species in Thailand of which 2 endemic: L. huamotensis, L. subangulata, and 1 introduced: L. indica.

description: Trees 10–40 m tall; trunk fluted towards the base, when mature hollow (always?); bark cream or greyish white, rather smooth, flaking, leaving roundish scars (tabaek). Leaves: petiole 0.5–1 cm long; lamina densely stellate short-hairy, upper surface glabrescent, 6–12(–20) by 1.5–4.5(–7.5) cm; lateral veins 6–10(–12) on each side; intercostal venation scalariform. Inflorescences terminal, lax, 10–20(–30) cm long, densely short stellate-hairy. Flowers fragrant, (sub)sessile; bud densely fine stellate-hairy, obconical, ca 6 mm long, slightly nippled at apex, pseudopedicel absent or less than 1 mm long; calyx tube ca 5 mm long, not or obscurely ridged, auricles absent; calyx lobes whitish hairy within, ca 2 mm long; petals white (or purple), blade obovate, 3–7 mm long, margin entire, claw ca 3 mm long; stamens ± radially dimorphic; ovary hairy. Capsules black, glossy, smooth (not shagreen), hairy at apex, ellipsoid, ca 10 mm long, 5-(or 6-)valved; fruiting calyx not ridged; lobes thin, in upper half hairy or glabrescent within, appressed to the capsule or reflexed; fruiting pseudopedicel 1 mm long or less.

description: Trees 4–10(–30) m tall; older trunks fluted; bark light brown, thin, flaking, mottled, (tabaek); short shoots sometimes spine-tipped. Leaves: petiole 0.2–1 cm long; lamina densely rust coloured short-hairy, becoming glabrous above, but somewhat hairy especially on veins beneath, 4–15(–19) cm long; lateral veins 6–8(–12) on each side; intercostal venation reticulate or faintly scalariform. Inflorescences terminal, lax, 7–30 cm long, few- or many-flowered, wholly densely rust coloured short-hairy, hairs stellate-dendroid. Flowers: bud densely rust coloured short-hairy, obconical, sometimes flattened at apex and to 2 mm nippled, 7–10 mm long, pseudopedicel 2–5 mm long; calyx tube ca 8 mm long, not or vaguely ridged, auricles absent; calyx lobes in upper half hairy within, 3–4 mm long; petals violet, fading lilac to white with age, blade broadly elliptic, 10–25 mm long, margin entire, mostly undulate, claw ca 5 mm long; stamens radially dimorphic (5 or 6 outer stamens longer than numerous inner ones); ovary whitish hairy. Capsules black, smooth (not shagreen), often whitish hairy at apex, globose-ellipsoid, 14–17 mm long, 5- or 6-valved; fruiting calyx not ridged, auricles absent; lobes in upper half hairy within, appressed to the capsule or reflexed; fruiting pseudopedicel 2–5(–6) mm long.

description: Trees 5–10 m tall; bark not seen (probably roughly cracked, blackish (salao)). Leaves: petiole 0.3–0.4 cm long; lamina glabrous except for short pale hairs on veins on both surfaces, 6–15 cm long; lateral veins 5–7 on each side; intercostal venation scalariform-reticulate. Inflorescences terminal, lax, to 20 cm long, minutely hairy (hairs simple). Flowers: bud glabrous or scarcely hairy, obconical, ca 6 mm long, pseudopedicel ca 2 mm long; calyx tube 5–6 mm long, 6-winged, wings 2 mm wide, crispate-undulate, auricles undulately subcircular passing into low wings at both sides of the sutures of the calyx lobes; calyx lobes glabrous within, ca 3 mm long; petals purplish (?), blade elliptic, ca 5 mm long, margin entire, claw ca 2 mm long; stamens not seen but perhaps radially dimorphic; ovary glabrous. Capsules unknown, but the surface should be glabrous and presumably shagreen.

description: Stunted treelets 4–5(–15) m tall; bark blackish (salao); twigs finely striate, (grey-)brown, 2–3 mm diam. Leaves: petiole 0.2–0.4 cm long; lamina (sub)coriaceous, glabrous at both sides, drying brown-green above, green underneath, broadly (ob)ovate-elliptic, 4–9 by (2.5–)3–5 cm, base short-attenuate or rounded, apex short-acute-acuminate but tip withered; lateral veins 5(–7) on each side; intercostal venation finely reticulate, distinct. Panicle (in fruit) terminal, erect, short, 2–5 cm long, not or hardly branched, lateral branches to 0.3 cm long, glabrous (glabrescent). Flowers: bud whitish, glabrous, obovoid, shortly nippled at apex, 10–12 mm long, pseudopedicel 8–10 mm long; calyx tube glabrous, not ridged, without auricles; calyx lobes glabrous within, ca 5 mm long, subacute; petals white, blade suborbicular, 12–15 mm long, margin subentire, claw 8–10 mm long; stamens radially or asymmetrically dimorphic (outer 10–12 stamens longer than inner ones); ovary glabrous. Capsules 1–5 per infructescence, blackish, smooth and indistinctly wrinkled (not shagreen), glabrous, ellipsoid, 20–25 by ca 15 mm, 4- or 5-valved; fruiting calyx turbinate or campanulate, ca 10 by 10–15 mm, not ridged, glabrous (or glabrescent from minute hairs), calyx lobes 6, glabrous within, 5–7 mm long, without auricles at the sinuses between the calyx lobes, reflexed; pseudopedicel (straight or) up-curved, 15–18 mm long.

description: Shrubs or small trees to 3 m tall; bark smooth, flaky (tabaek). Leaves (sub)sessile; lamina minutely hairy on both surfaces when young, glabrescent, 3–6(–10) cm long; lateral veins 5–7 on each side; intercostal venation reticulate. Inflorescences terminal, glabrous, lax, 5–20 cm long. Flowers: bud glabrous, globose, 5–7 mm diam., pseudopedicel 2–10 mm long; calyx tube glabrous, 3–4 mm long, not ridged or ridges slightly developed; auricles absent; calyx lobes 6, glabrous within, 3–4 mm long; petals pink, lilac, or white, blade suborbicular, 8–10 mm long, margin undulate and crispate, claw ca10 mm long; stamens radially dimorphic (4 or 6 outer stamens longer than numerous inner ones); ovary glabrous, style ca 10 mm long. Capsules smooth (not shagreen), glabrous, 10–15 mm long, 4–6-valved; fruiting calyx tube not ridged, lobes thin, persistent or caducous; fruiting pseudopedicel ca 8 mm long.

description: Trees 5–16 m high; bark smooth, creamy pale brown, flaking in thin scales (tabaek). Leaves glabrous; petiole ca 0.5 cm long; lamina 7–12 by 3–5 cm; lateral veins 6–8 on each side; intercostal venation reticulate. Inflorescences terminal, lax, ca 20 cm long, densely short-hairy, hairs stellate. Flowers: bud densely stellate-hairy, obonical, flat at apex, 1.5 mm nippled, ca 8 mm long, pseudopedicel 3–5 mm long; calyx tube ca 7 mm long, distinctly 12-ridged, with sepal-like auricles; calyx lobes glabrous within, ca 4 mm long; petals purple, blade broadly ovate, ca 15 mm long, margin subentire, undulate, claw ca 5 mm long; stamens asymmetrically dimorphic (outer 6 or 7 stamens longer than inner ones and directed towards a gap between the petals), ovary hairy. Capsules blackish, smooth, indistinctly wrinkled (not shagreen), hairy, especially at apex, 15–18 mm long, 6-valved; fruiting calyx densely stellate-hairy, distinctly 12-ridged, calyx lobes thin, reflexed, glabrous within, with distinct auricles at the sinuses between the calyx lobes; pseudopedicel ca 5 mm long.

description: Trees 4–10 m tall; bark light brown, thin, vertically cracked and flaking (salao). Leaves: petiole ca 0.5 cm long; lamina shortly soft-hairy beneath, 4–20 cm long; lateral veins 8–13 on each side; intercostal venation scalariform. Inflorescences lateral (axillary), lax, 10–18(–25) cm long. Flowers: bud stellate-dendroid hairy, obovoid, 5–9 mm long, pseudopedicel 2(–7) mm long; calyx tube 3–4 mm long, nearly without ridges or faintly 12-ridged, without auricles; calyx lobes 6 (or 7), hairy in upper half within, 3–4 mm long; petals (dark) purple, turning white with age, blade ovate or obovate, 15–20 mm long, margin irregularly serrate-fimbriate, especially so in upper half, claw ca 7 mm long; stamens asymmetrically dimorphic (outer 6 or 7 stamens longer than inner ones and directed towards a gap between the petals); ovary hairy. Capsules black, glossy, smooth, coarsely reticulate when dry (not shagreen), often hairy at apex, globose or broadly ellipsoid, (10–)12–18 mm long, 5- or 6-valved; fruiting calyx without distinct ridges; calyx lobes thin, hairy or with remnants of hairs within, reflexed; fruiting pseudopedicel 2–4(–7) mm long.

description: Deciduous trees (1–)4–12 m tall; bark grey or brown, thin, cracked and flaking (inthanin). Leaves: petiole 1–2 cm long; lamina glabrous, sometimes obovate, 10–35 cm long; lateral veins 7–12 on each side; intercostal venation reticulate. Inflorescences terminal, lax, to 25 cm long, at first finely hairy, glabrescent. Flowers: bud glabrous, subglobose or obovoid, not nippled at apex, 10–16 mm long, pseudopedicel 4–15(–20) mm long; calyx tube 5–8 mm long, not ridged or indistinctly 12-ridged, without auricles (at most with a minute wart); calyx lobes glabrous within, ca 10 mm long; petals violet or pink, fading paler with age, blade subcircular, 30–40 mm long, margin entire, slightly undulate, claw 10(–15) mm long; stamens numerous, monomorphic (all of about the same length); ovary glabrous. Capsules brown, dull, often wrinkled (not shagreen), 30–40 mm long, 6-valved; fruiting calyx slightly or distinctly 12-rided, the ridges blunt or irregularly coarsely incised; calyx lobes 1–2 mm thick, glabrous within, patent or reflexed, without auricles at the sinuses between the calyx lobes; fruiting pseudopedicel stout, (5–)10–25 mm long.

description: Shrubs or small trees 1–3(–8) m tall; bark greyish, smooth (tabaek). Leaves: petiole 0.3–0.5 cm long; lamina glabrous or densely or thinly stellate-hairy below, 3–6(–8.5) by 1.5–3(–3.5) cm; lateral veins 6–8 on each side; intercostal venation reticulate. Inflorescences terminal, lax, variable, 7–27 cm long, wholly densely brown short-hairy (hairs stellate). Flowers: bud densely brown short-hairy, obconical, sometimes 6-angular, shortly nippled at apex, 6–8 mm long, pseudopedicel ca 2 mm long; calyx tube 5–7 mm long, not ridged, without auricles, calyx lobes densely pale-hairy in upper part within, ca 5 mm long; petals purple, blade broadly ovate, 8–12 mm long, margin entire, somewhat undulate, claw ca 4 mm long; stamens asymmetrically dimorphic (outer 9 to 11 stamens longer than inner ones and directed towards a gap between the petals); ovary densely hairy. Capsules dark brown or black, smooth (not shagreen), often densely whitish hairy at apex, globose-ellipsoid, ca 10 mm long, 5- or 6-valved; fruiting calyx not ridged; calyx lobes hairy within, appressed to the capsule or reflexed; fruiting pseudopedicel 2–5 mm long.

description: Trees (4–)10–30 m tall; bark smooth or with pustules, pale grey (tabaek) when young but roughly blackish fissured (salao) when older. Leaves: petiole 0.2–0.4 cm long; lamina glabrous except minutely simple-hairy veins below, 6–11 cm long; lateral veins 5–9 on each side; intercostal venation subscalariform or reticulate. Inflorescences terminal, lax, 15–25 cm long, wholly densely extremely short-hairy, hairs simple. Flowers: bud extremely short-hairy, obovoid, shortly nippled at apex, 10–15 mm long, pseudopedicel ca 1 mm long; calyx tube distinctly 6–9-ridged, ridges 0.5–1.5 mm wide, at apex confluent into auricles, calyx lobes (6–)7–9, minutely hairy in upper part within, 6–8 mm long; petals purple, blade broadly elliptic, 10–15 mm long, margin entire, somewhat undulate, claw 6–10 mm long; stamens radially dimorphic (6 or 7 outer stamens longer than numerous inner ones); ovary glabrous. Capsule brown, dull, shagreen, glabrous, 15–20 mm long, 5- or 6-valved; fruiting calyx distinctly (6–)7–9-ridged, ridges 0.5–1 mm wide; calyx lobes thin, glabrous (glabrescent) within, patent, without or with small auricles at the sinuses between the calyx lobes; fruiting pseudopedicel (1–)2–3 mm long.

description: Trees 5–30 m tall; bark light brown, black when old, coarsely vertically cracked and slightly flaking (inthanin). Leaves: petiole 0.5–1 cm long; lamina membranous or chartaceous, glabrous, dull, elliptic or obovate, 10–20 cm long; lateral veins (6–)8–14 on each side; intercostal venation reticulate or reticulate-scalariform. Inflorescences terminal, lax or elongate, 15–25 cm long, when young densely short stellate-hairy, becoming glabrous. Flowers: bud short-farinose, subglobose, ca 0.5 mm nippled at apex, ca 8 mm diam., pseudopedicel 3–8 mm long; calyx tube 6–8 mm long, distinctly 12-ridged, the ridges low; calyx lobes glabrous within, to 8 mm long, auricles between the sinuses absent or as minute warts; petals purple, blade obovate, ca 20 mm long, upper part of margin irregularly undulate, claw ca 5 mm long; stamens numerous, monomorphic (all of about the same length); ovary glabrous. Capsules brown or black, dull, smooth (not shagreen), glabrous, 15–25 mm long, 6-valved; fruiting calyx 12-ridged, the ridges not winged; calyx lobes glabrous within, ± thin, often reflexed, without auricles; fruiting pseudopedicel 5–10(–12) mm long.

description: Trees 3–5 m tall; bark of trunk brown grey, thin, peeling or flaking (tabaek). Leaves: petiole 0.2–0.4 cm long; lamina sparingly stellate-hairy then glabrous beneath, ovate or obovate, 4–13 by 4–5 cm, nerves 5–8 on each side, raised on both surfaces; intercostal venation reticulate. Inflorescences terminal, lax, finely stellate-hairy, 20–30 cm long. Flowers: bud densely pale yellow stellate-hairy, broadly obconical or obovate, more or less convex at apex with lobed nipple, bud 5–8 mm long, pseudopedicel 2–4 mm long; calyx tube 5–7 mm long, distinctly 12-ridged, ridges winged, wing 2–3 mm wide (not extending to the pseudopedicel), auricles ca 2 mm long, ± inward curved in bud; calyx lobes hairy at apex within, ca 4 mm long; petals pink-purple fading to white with age, blade obovate or subcircular, 10–15 mm long, margin entire, undulate, claw ca 3 mm long; stamens asymmetrically dimorphic (outer 6 or 7 stamens longer than inner ones and directed towards a gap between the petals); ovary hairy. Capsules smooth (not shagreen), short-hairy towards apex, ovoid-ellipsoid, (10–)12–14 mm long, 6-valved; fruiting calyx densely stellate hairy, 4–7 mm long, 12-ridged, ridges somewhat undulately winged, wings ca 2 mm wide or eroded, lobes reflexed, hairy at apex within; fruiting pseudopedicel 3–5 mm long.

description: Shrubs or trees to 20 m tall; bark brown or black, thin, smooth, later (roughly) cracked, flaking or not (salao). Leaves: petiole 0.1–0.3 cm long; lamina glabrous, but veins on lower surface pale short-hairy, 4–12 cm long; lateral veins 7–10 on each side; intercostal venation finely reticulate. Inflorescences terminal, lax, to 30 cm long, densely short-hairy, hairs greyish, simple. Flowers: bud densely short-hairy, especially on the ridges, obovoid, 3–5 mm long, pseudopedicel 1(–2) mm long; calyx tube 3–4 mm long, 6-ridged, without auricles, the ridges straight or sinuate (undulate); calyx lobes minutely hairy at apex within, ca 2 mm long; petals pink or violet, blade rhombic, 5–7 mm long (including claw), margin undulate-serrate; stamens radially dimorphic (6 or 7 outer stamens longer than numerous inner ones); ovary glabrous. Capsules (pale) brown, dull, shagreen (finely longitudinally striate), glabrous, 12–18 mm long, 4-valved; fruiting calyx with 6 distinct ridges, the ridges straight or ± undulate; calyx lobes thin, without auricles at the sinuses between the calyx lobes, lobes reflexed; fruiting pseudopedicel 1(–2) mm long.

description: Deciduous or evergreen trees 5–35 m tall, sometimes coppicing at base; bark light brown, thin or thick, finely or roughly vertically cracking (salao). Leaves: petiole 0.5–0.8 cm long; lamina densely soft hairy, hairs stellate, becoming glabrous above and hairy or glabrescent below, 7–17(–25) cm long; lateral veins 6–10(–12) on each side; intercostal venation scalariform. Inflorescences terminal or partly lateral, lax, to 40 cm long, wholly finely short-hairy, hairs stellate or dendroid. Flowers: bud short-hairy, obovoid, ca 7 mm long, pseudopedicel ca 1 mm long; calyx tube 3–4 mm long, 12-ridged, without auricles; calyx lobes glabrous within, ca 3 mm long; petals white or light blue to lilac turning white, blade elliptic, acute, 10–15 mm long, margin entire but crenulate-subfimbriate at apex, claw ca 5 mm long; stamens radially dimorphic (6 or 7 outer stamens longer than numerous inner ones); ovary hairy. Capsules black, glossy, smooth or coarsely retiulate-wrinkled (not shagreen), hairy when young, becoming glabrous but hairy at apex, 10–17 mm long, 6-valved; fruiting calyx ca 12-ridged (sometimes fewer), the ridges not winged; calyx lobes glabrous inside, thin, without auricles at the sinuses between the calyx lobes, reflexed; fruiting pseudopedicel 1–5 mm long.

description: Trees to 20 m tall; bark light brown, blackish or grey, thick and vertically roughly cracked (salao). Leaves: petiole 0.3–0.5(–1) cm long; lamina densely finely hairy on both surfaces, hairs simple, 0.5 mm long, later glabrous on upper leaf surface except for midrib and veins, 5–10(–15) by 2–5 cm; lateral veins 5–8 on each side; intercostal venation reticulate(-scalariform). Inflorescences terminal, condensed, 2.5–8 cm long, densely finely white-hairy. Flowers: bud densely finely white-hairy, obconical, (3–)4–5 mm long, pseudopedicel 1–2 mm long; calyx tube ca 3 mm long, distinctly 4–6-ridged, ridges irregularly undulately winged, auricles absent; calyx lobes glabrous within, ca 2 mm long; petals white, small or absent, blade elliptic ca 4 mm long (including claw), margin entire; stamens radially dimorphic (6 or 7 outer stamens longer than numerous inner ones); ovary glabrous. Infructescences compact; capsules (pale) brown, dull, shagreen (finely longitudinally striate), glabrous, 15–17 mm long, 4- or 5-valved; fruiting calyx tube with irregularly winged ridges, calyx lobes small, thin; fruiting pseudopedicel 1–2(–3) mm long.

description: Shrubs 1.5–6 m tall, lateral twiglets spiny or not, glabrous. Leaves opposite, short petioled. Inflorescences small (or large) terminal (or axillary) leafy panicles. Flowers 4-merous, actinomorphic; bracteoles 2, minute; calyx tube short obconical, deeply divided, calyx lobes (sepals) 4, ovate, epicalyx appendages absent; small crenate disc inside at base of calyx tube present; petals reniform, crumpled, very shortly clawed, longer than calyx lobes; stamens usually 8, in 4 pairs, inserted near base of the calyx lobes; ovary free, sessile, subglobose, (2–)4-celled, ovules numerous, placentas axillary, style slender, slightly longer than stamens, stigma punctiform. Capsule (depressed) globose, sessile in calyx tube, much exserted, indehiscent, many-seeded. Seeds obpyramidal, unwinged; cotyledons flat.</br></br>One species. Probably native to E Africa and SW Asia, in dryer areas; frequently planted as an ornamental or a dye plant.

description: Shrubs, often much branched, with spiny short shoots or shoots not spiny, young branchlets sharply angular (winged), old ones almost terete. Leaves membranous, elliptic, oblong or subovate, base acute, apex acute short-acuminate, glabrous, 1.5–5 by 1–2(–3) cm; petiole 0.2–0.5 cm. Panicles often gathered into a compound inflorescence to 20 cm long. Flowers fragrant; calyx tube ca 1.5 mm long, calyx lobes acute, 2–2.5 mm long; petals at first light yellow, turning red or not, longer than the calyx lobes, ca 3 by 4 mm; stamens patent, about twice as long as calyx lobes, falling off after anthesis, anthers small. Capsules 5–8 mm across, crowned by the style or short style base remnant. Seeds with testa apically thickened, spongy, thinner and hard towards the base.

description: Herbs, occasionally woody at base (seldom shrubs or trees, not in Thailand); roots fibrous. Leaves alternate or distichous. Inflorescences: flowers solitary and axillary or in terminal racemes or in panicles of racemes. Flowers pedicellate or sessile; bracteoles small, linear, or absent; sepals persistent; corolla zygomorphic, dorsally deeply divided, bilabiate (upper lip 2-lobed, lower lip 3-lobed), or unilabiate; stamens partially connate, enveloping the style, anthers (partly) bearded at apex (or not bearded, not in Thailand); ovary inferior (seldom superior, not in Thailand), stigma 2-lobed. Fruit a capsule opening with 2 valves at apex, or a berry. Seeds numerous, ellipsoid or trigonous, ca 1 mm long, smooth or finely sculptured.</br></br>A genus of about 400 species distributed throughout the tropics and subtropics, a few in temperate areas; 14 species in Thailand.

description: Subperennial herb, glabrous; stems few or several, ascending, to 20 cm tall, angular or winged. Leaves alternate; petiole to 0.4 cm long or leaves subsessile; blades of lower and upper leaves similar, subcircular or ovate-elliptic, to 1.3 cm long. Flowers solitary; pedicel to 25 mm long; bracteoles present; ovary glabrous; corolla bilabiate, dark purple, 5–7 mm long; anthers all bearded at apex. Fruit a capsule, glabrous. Seeds trigonous.

description: Perennial herb, glabrous, caespitose, branches ascending, rooting at lower nodes, to 15 cm tall; stem subterete. Leaves alternate, distichous; petiole absent, lower and upper blades similar; (broadly) elliptic, to 2 cm long. Flowers: solitary; pedicel 20–45 mm long; bracteoles absent; ovary glabrous; corolla unilabiate, lobes placed more or less in one plane, pale blue or pale pink, 10–15 mm long; only 2 anthers bearded at apex. Fruit a capsule, glabrous. Seeds compressed, ellipsoid.

description: Perennial herb, 30–100 cm tall, erect, unbranched, glabrous except for somewhat hairy nodes. Leaves alternate; radical leaves: petiole to 11 cm long; blade oblong-lanceolate, ca 15 by 3 cm; cauline leaves subsessile; blade obovate-oblong or linear-lanceolate, 3.5–17 by 0.8–3 cm, base cuneate, apex rounded but shortly mucronate. Inflorescence a lax or dense terminal raceme, 15–30 cm long; bracts shorter or longer than flowers, 1.3–3.5 by 0.3–0.5 cm. Flowers: pedicel 3–8 mm long, with two minute bracteoles at or below the middle; ovary ± ellipsoid, ca 3 mm long; sepals linear, 5–12 by 1–2 mm; corolla bilabiate, purple-blue, 12–24 mm long, upper lobes linear, 11–15 mm long, lower lobes ovate-oblong, 4–8 mm long; filamental tube glabrous 7–12 mm long, anther tube glabrous, sparsely or densely hairy along sutures, 4–6 mm long, 2 anthers bearded at apex. Fruit a capsule, ovoid-globose ca 6 by 4–6 mm. Seeds ellipsoid.

description: Annual or subperennial herb, glabrous, branches several, ascending, to 25(–40) cm tall; stem subterete or angular. Leaves alternate; petiole of lower leaves to 0.3 cm long, the upper ones sessile; lower blades broadly elliptic, upper ones narrowly elliptic or linear, 1.2–2.5 by 0.4–1 cm. Flowers solitary; pedicel 10–20(–25) mm long; bracteoles present; ovary glabrous; corolla bilabiate, blue or purple, seldom white, 6–9 mm long; anthers all bearded at apex. Fruit a capsule, glabrous. Seeds trigonous.

Leaves alternate; petiole absent or to 0.2 cm long; all blades ovate-elliptic, 1–2 cm long. Fruit a capsule, subglobose, rounded at base. Seeds trigonous.

Leaves alternate; petiole up to 0.4 cm long; blade to 3 cm long, lower ones broadly ovate or rhomboid, with narrowed base decurrent on the petiole, upper ones similar, but narrower and smaller. Flowers solitary, pedicel 5–20 mm long; bracteoles present; ovary glabrous; corolla bilabiate, upper lip mostly pale blue or white, lower lip with 3 purple blotches, 3–4(–5) mm long; only 2 anthers bearded at apex. Fruit a capsule, glabrous. Seeds compressed ellipsoid.

Leaves alternate; petiole absent; blade to 2 cm long, lower ones subcircular, upper ones (narrowly) elliptic. description: Low creeping herb, glabrous or hairy, rooting at the nodes; stem terete, plant 5–10 cm tall. Leaves alternate (distichous); petiole distinct, 0.3–1 cm long; lower and upper blades similar, subcircular, to 3 cm long. Flowers solitary; pedicel 10–40 mm long; bracteoles absent; ovary glabrous or hairy; corolla sub-bilabiate, pinkish, 5–12 mm long; only 2 anthers bearded at apex. Fruit a berry (also capsular in the Philippines, Sulawesi and New Guinea), ellipsoid or globose. Seeds compressed, ellipsoid, reticulate.

description: Large perennial erect herb, 40–300 cm tall, stem single, hollow, glabrous, profusely branched towards apex forming a pyramidal inflorescence. Leaves alternate; petiole short or absent; basal blades spatulate, cauline blades: lower ones oblong, to 25 cm long, middle and upper ones narrowly elliptic or narrowly oblong, 12–31 by 1–4 cm, base attenuate, margin serrulate, apex acuminate. Inflorescence a panicle, ca 50 cm long; bracts longer or shorter than flowers. Flowers: pedicel 6–24 mm long, bracteoles absent (or with two bracteoles, not in Thailand); ovary campanulate or broadly ellipsoid, 2–4 by 2–4 mm; sepals linear-triangular, 8–16 by 1–1.8 mm; corolla bilabiate, white (or pink or bluish, not in Thailand), 11–21 mm long, tube inside hairy, upper lobes linear, 7–15 mm long, lower lobes elliptic or lanceolate, 4–7 mm long; filamental tube glabrous ca 6 mm long, anther tube hairy along sutures, ca 5 mm long, 2 anthers bearded at apex. Fruit a capsule, subglobose or broadly ovoid, 3.5–6.5 mm diam. Seeds compressed, ellipsoid.

description: Large perennial erect herb, 50–300 cm tall, stem single, hollow, densely short-hairy, profusely branched towards apex where forming inflorescences. Leaves alternate, sessile; blade oblanceolate or oblong, uppermost ones narrowly elliptic or lanceolate, 7–30 by 2–6(–8) cm, base cuneate or attenuate, margin serrulate or crenulate, teeth usually conspicuously darker coloured, apex acuminate, acute, or obtuse. Inflorescence a dense panicle, 50 cm long or more; bracts 1–5 cm long. Flowers erect; pedicel 5–12 mm long, usually with two minute bracteoles, ca 1 mm long, about the middle; ovary campanulate or hemispherical, 3–6.5 by 3–6 mm; sepals linear-triangular, 7–16 by 0.7–2.5 mm, margin entire or with some teeth; corolla bilabiate, white, outside densely short hairy, inside hairy, 20–34 mm long, upper lobes linear, 2–5 mm long, lower lobes wider, 4–10 mm long; filamental tube hairy, ca 15 mm long, anther tube greyish black, hairy along sutures, 5–7.5 mm long, 2 anthers bearded at apex. Fruit a capsule, erect, subovoid or broadly ellipsoid, 6–13 by 5–9 mm. Seeds compressed, ellipsoid.

description: Perennial shrub-like herb, 100–200(–500, China) cm tall, with single main stem, glabrous, profusely branched towards apex forming inflorescences; stem faintly longitudinally ribbed. Leaves alternate, sessile; blade oblong or oblanceolate, 17 by 2 cm, base long-attenuate, margin minutely serrulate, apex acute-acuminate; uppermost blades narrowly lanceolate, ca 8 by 0.8 cm, gradually diminishing in size towards the apex. Inflorescence a large panicle, the branches ending into flowering racemes ca 8 cm long; lower bracts ca 2.5 by 0.4 cm long, upper bracts gradually shorter. Flowers: pedicel ca 20 mm long, with 2 linear bracteoles; ovary obconic, 2.5–8 mm long, indistinctly ribbed; sepals linear, 3–10(–27, China) by ca 1 mm, margin entire; corolla purple (pale blue or pinkish, China), inside (sparsely) hairy, 20–34 mm long, upper lobes linear, ca 16 mm long, lower lobes ca 11 mm long; anther tube densely finely white-hairy, ca 6 mm long, 2 anthers bearded at apex. Fruit a capsule, pendent, semi-globose, ca 5 mm diam. (10–16 by 5–9 mm, China), slightly ribbed. Seeds ellipsoid.

description: Annual herb, soft-pubescent, sometimes glabrescent (see note), erect or suberect and branching from (somewhat) above the base, 5–10 cm tall; stem subterete; roots fibrous, not spongy. Leaves alternate, subsessile or petiole to 0.2 cm long and ± winged; lower blades subcircular or broadly ovate, to 1.8 cm long, upper blades smaller, the uppermost also narrower. Flowers solitary; pedicel comparatively long, 15–35(–40) mm long; bracteoles absent or present (see note); ovary soft hairy (or glabrous, see note); corolla bilabiate, pale blue, 4–7(–8) mm long; anthers all bearded at apex. Fruit a capsule, hairy, glabrescent or glabrous (see note). Seeds trigonous.

description: Annual herb, sparingly soft-hairy, especially on ovary (partly glabrescent), few-branched at base, branches ascending, 5–10 cm tall; not or rarely rooting at the lower nodes; stem subterete (narrowly winged when dry). Leaves alternate; petiole to 0.2 cm long; lower blades subcircular, to 2 cm long, narrowly cuneate at base, upper ones smaller, only somewhat narrower, (narrowly) ovate. Flowers solitary; pedicel 15–60 mm long; bracteoles linear, 2 mm long; ovary soft-hairy; corolla bilabiate, bright blue, but upper lobes lilac (pinkish), 7–10 mm long; anthers all bearded at apex. Fruit a capsule, hairy (or glabrescent). Seeds trigonous.

description: (Sub)perennial herb, usually hairy to some degree, decumbent, creeping, ascendant, to 10 cm tall, rooting at lower nodes; stem subterete; roots fibrous. Leaves alternate; petiole (0.2–)0.4–1 cm long; lower and upper blades similar, broadly ovate, 1.5–3.5(–5.5) cm long. Flowers solitary; pedicel 10–25 mm long; bracteoles absent (always?); ovary usually (soft) hairy; corolla bilabiate, pale blue, 5–8(–15, not in Thailand, see note 2) mm long; anthers all bearded at apex. Fruit a capsule, usually hairy. Seeds trigonous.

description: Herbs, shrubs, or rarely small trees; stems glabrous or pubescent, erect to prostrate and then often rooting at nodes, sometimes floating, underwater parts often swollen and spongy or with inflated white spongy pneumatophores. Leaves alternate (or opposite, not in Thailand), usually entire; stipules present, often deciduous. Inflorescences terminal spikes or racemes, pedicellate or sessile; bracteoles 2, at or near base of ovary, or absent. Flowers perfect, actinomorphic, in upper leaf axils or in spikes, racemes, or clusters; floral tube not prolonged beyond ovary; sepals (3 or)4 or 5(–7), green, persistent after anthesis; petals as many as sepals or absent (not in Thailand), yellow or white, caducous; stamens as many or twice as many as sepals; anthers versatile or sometimes basifixed; pollen shed in monads, tetrads or polyads; ovary with as many locules as sepals, rarely more, apex flat or conical, often with a depressed nectary surrounding base of each epipetalous stamen; stigma capitate or hemispherical, entire or lobed, distal ½–⅔ receptive. Fruit a capsule, obconic, obovoid, cylindrical or globose, dehiscent irregularly or by a terminal pore or by flaps separating from valve-like apex. Seeds numerous, in one to several rows per locule, free or embedded in powdery or woody endocarp, raphe small or conspicuous, sometimes equal in size to body of seed. 2n = 16, 32, 48, 64, 80, 96, 128.</br></br>Eighty-two species; cosmopolitan, except Antarctica; 6 species in Thailand.

description: Herbs, perennial with creeping or floating stems, rooting at nodes, with white, erect, short (1–3 cm), spindle-shaped pneumatophores in clusters at nodes of glabrous floating stems to 400 cm; terrestrial stems 20–60 cm, much branched, tips ascending, densely villous on branches. Leaves oblong to spathulate-oblong, 0.4–7 by 0.7–4 cm, glabrous, base narrowly cuneate or attenuate, apex obtuse to subacute, margin entire; lateral veins 6–13 per side, submarginal vein not prominent; petiole 5–20 mm. Flower sepals 5, deltoid-acuminate, 5–11 mm, glabrous or villous; petals obovate, 9–18 by 6–10 mm, creamy white with yellow base; stamens 10, filaments white, 2.5–4 mm, anthers 0.7–1.8 mm, pollen in monads; style white, 4–10 mm, glabrous, stigma discoid. Capsule cylindrical, terete, 12–27 mm, 3–4 mm in diam., glabrous or villous, thick-walled, tardily and irregularly dehiscent, light brown with dark brown ribs; pedicel 15–55 mm. Seeds in one row per locule, firmly embedded in coherent cubes of woody endocarp fused to capsule wall, oblong or elliptic, 1.1–1.3 mm, raphe inconspicuous, pale brown. Fl. Apr–Nov, fr. May–Nov. 2n = 32.

description: Herbs erect, annual, sometimes woody at base and perennial, often in water and then with elongate pneumatophores on submerged branches; stems 5–300 cm tall, branched, new growth and inflorescence minutely puberulent. Leaves lanceolate, 1–9 by 0.2–3 cm, subglabrous or puberulent, base narrowly cuneate, apex acuminate; lateral veins 7–15 per side, submarginal vein inconspicuous; petiole 3–18 mm. Flower sepals 4, lanceolate, 2–4 mm, finely puberulent; petals elliptic, 2–3 by 1–2 mm, yellow, fading orange-yellow; stamens twice as many as sepals, anthers 0.4–0.6, pollen in monads; style 1–1.5 mm, stigma depressed-globose. Capsule cylindrical and subterete, enlarged in upper ⅙–⅓, 15–30 mm, finely puberulent, relatively thin-walled; subsessile. Seeds in inflated upper capsule in 2 or more rows per locule, free, ovoid, 0.3–0.5 mm, raphe narrow, pale brown; seeds in lower capsule in one row per locule, embedded in cube of relatively hard endocarp, 0.7–0.9 mm, raphe ca ⅓ width of seed, brown. Fl. Jun–Feb, fr. Jun–Feb. 2n = 16

description: Robust perennial herbs or shrubs with woody base; stems 25–400 cm tall, well branched, densely covered with spreading pubescence at least on upper stem, or puberulent or subglabrous. Leaves linear to subovate, 1–14 by 0.3–4 cm, base narrowly or broadly cuneate, apex attenuate; lateral veins 11–20 per side, submarginal vein prominent; petioles 1–10 mm. Flower sepals 4, ovate or lanceolate, 6–15 mm; petals, broadly obovate, 6–17 by 5–17 mm, yellow; stamens 8, filaments 1–4 mm, anthers 1.2–4 mm, pollen in tetrads; style 1.5–3.5 mm, stigma subglobose, shallowly 4-lobed. Capsule cylindrical, terete, 17–45 mm, 2–8 mm in diam., thin-walled, readily and irregularly loculicidal, pale brown with 8 darker ribs; pedicel 1–10 mm. Seeds in 2 or more rows per locule, free, 0.6–0.75 mm, raphe inflated and equal in size to seed body, brown, evenly transversely ridged. Fl. Jan–Dec, fr. Jan–Dec. 2n = 32, 48.

description: Herbs erect, annual, with taproot; stems 20–100 cm tall, branched, subglabrous or minutely puberulent on younger parts. Leaves narrowly elliptic to lanceolate, 1–11 by 0.3–2.7 cm, base narrowly cuneate, apex subacute; lateral veins 6–12 per side, submarginal vein inconspicuous; petiole 2–15 mm, winged. Flower sepals 4(5), deltate, (1.3–)2–3.5 mm, glabrous or minutely puberulent; petals elliptic, 1–3 by 0.7–2 mm, yellow; stamens as many as sepals, or rarely more, filaments 0.3–0.7 mm, anthers 0.5–0.7 mm, pollen in tetrads; style 0.7–1.5 mm, stigma globose. Capsule oblanceoloid, terete, 3–16(–19) mm, 2.5–5 mm in diam., thin-walled, readily and irregularly loculicidal, glabrous or puberulent, often nodding, pale brown, pedicel 0–6 mm. Seeds in 2 or more rows per locule, free, 0.3–0.5 mm, raphe very narrow and inconspicuous, brown with fine brown lines. Fl. Jul–Nov, fr. Jul–Nov. 2n = 16.

description: Robust herbs or shrubs with woody base; stems 25–400 cm, erect or sometimes decumbent, terete or angled, 1.5–2.5 cm thick, with peeling bark, rarely succulent, profusely branched, villous, with usually tawny, multicellular hairs, deciduous with age and rarely subglabrous. Leaves lanceolate, elliptic or wide elliptic, sometimes ovate, occasionally obovate or rounded, 2–20(–45) by 1–10 cm, villous or sometimes glabrous, base obtuse or cuneate, rarely asymmetrical, apex acute or acuminate or rarely rounded; submarginal vein prominent, gland-toothed at margin; petiole 0–15 mm. Bracts usually not strongly reduced. Flower sepals 4(–5), ovate or ovate-lanceolate, 10–23 mm; petals yellow, 4(–5), orbicular or obovate, rarely emarginate, short-clawed, 10–40 by 10–40 mm; stamens 8(10), subequal; filaments 1.5–5 mm; anthers 3–6 mm; pollen in polyads; style 1.5–3.5 mm; stigma 1.6–3.5 mm, globose. Capsules obconical, with 4(5) prominent ribs, rarely subterete, 10–40 mm, 4–13 mm in diam., brown, thin-walled, irregularly loculicidal, villous or rarely glabrous; pedicel 5–65 mm. Seeds in 2 or more rows per locule, free, 0.6-0.9 mm, brown or reddish brown, evenly transversely ridged, raphe inconspicuous. Fl. Jul–Nov, fr. Aug–Jan. 2n = 64, 80, 96, 128.

description: Herbs erect, annual or short-lived perennial; stems 10–60 cm tall, often branched, subglabrous, often red tinged. Leaves elliptic to narrowly elliptic, 1–13 by 0.3–2.7 cm, glabrous or with few hairs on veins, base narrowly cuneate, apex acute, lateral veins 8–12 per side, submarginal vein inconspicuous; petiole 4–25 mm. Flower sepals 4, deltate, 1.3–2.5 mm, glabrous; petals narrowly spathulate, 1.3–2.2 mm, yellow; stamens as many as sepals, filaments 0.4–0.6 mm, anthers 0.3–0.4 mm, pollen in tetrads; style 0.8–1 mm, stigma globose. Capsule subcylindrical and slightly 4-angled, 12–22 mm, glabrous, thin-walled, readily and irregularly dehiscent, seeds clearly visible in outline through walls, pale brown, pedicel 0–1.5 mm. Seeds in one row per locule, free, 0.5–0.6 mm, raphe narrow, inconspicuous, pale brown with darker specks or transverse fine stripes. 2n = 16.

description: Tree ca 20 m tall; branchlets reddish brown or greyish tomentose or glabrescent. Leaves mostly spirally tufted at the ends of branchlets or scattered; lamina coriaceous, obovate or elliptic, 4–9 by 2–4.5 cm; apex obtusely acuminate; base cuneate, decurrent; upper surface sparsely short appressed hairy or glabrous; lower surface sparsely short appressed hairy; midrib grooved above, minutely crested, rounded below; secondary veins 10–13 on each side, looped; tertiary veins reticulate; petioles 1–1.5 cm long, grooved at apex, rounded and thickened at base, with appressed hairs, glabrescent; stipules triangular, 3 by 1–2 mm, reddish brown tomentose outside, glabrous inside, caducous. Flowers 1–2 in axils of leaves or fallen leaves; pedicels angular, 2–2.3 cm long, tomentose. Sepals 4, reddish brown tomentose except for a glabrous basal part inside; outer sepals ovate to broadly ovate, 7.5 by 5–7.5 mm; inner sepals broadly ovate or orbicular, 7.2–8 by 5.8–6.5 mm, with membranous, glabrous, fimbriate margin. Corolla 1–1.2 cm long, glabrous except for reddish brown woolly hairs between the stamens; tube 2–3 mm long; lobes 9–10, ovate-lanceolate or elliptic, 7.5–8.2 by 2–3.2 mm long. Stamens 20, 4.7–5 mm long; filaments subulate, 1–1.3 mm long, reddish brown woolly; anthers oblong, 3.5–3.8 mm long; sparsely hairy; connective acute or bifid, 0.6–0.9 mm long. Ovary globose, 8–9-locular, glabrous; style 1.5–1.7 cm long, glabrous. Fruits unknown.

description: Tree 6 m tall; branchlets stout, brownish puberulous or glabrescent. Leaves mostly spirally tufted at the ends of branchlets; lamina coriaceous, elliptic or obovate, 11–13.5 by 4.9–6 cm; apex acute or obtuse; base cuneate, decurrent; young leaves yellowish brown sericeous on both surfaces; mature leaves glabrous except sparsely tomentose on the lower surface; midrib grooved above with two minute crests, rounded below; secondary veins 14–16 on each side, vanishing near the margin, rarely looped in apical part of leaf; tertiary veins reticulate; petiole 2–2.5 cm long, grooved at apex, rounded and thickened at base, yellowish brown tomentose when young, turning reddish brown, glabrescent; stipules unknown. Flowers immature, 2–3 in axils of leaves; pedicels 4-angular, yellowish brown tomentose. Sepals 4, broadly ovate, crested, yellowish brown tomentose outside, reddish brown tomentose inside except for a glabrous basal part. Corolla 10-lobed; base obovate or oblong, reddish brown tomentose along mid-line or sparsely hairy outside, glabrous inside. Stamens 26, entirely glabrous; filaments filiform; anthers oblong ovate. Ovary disciform, 6-locular, glabrous; style glabrous. Fruits unknown.

description: Tree to 25 m tall; branchlets stout, reddish brown woolly or glabrescent. Leaves mostly spirally tufted at the ends of branchlets; lamina chartaceous, narrowly elliptic or oblanceolate, 8–20 by 1.8–5.5 cm; apex acute, somewhat apiculate; base cuneate, decurrent; both surfaces glabrous; midrib grooved above, minutely crested, rounded below; secondary veins 20–23 on each side, vanishing near the margin, somewhat looped in apical part of leaf; tertiary veins transverse and reticulately connected; petioles (1.3–) 2–4 cm long, grooved and sparsely woolly at apex, rounded at base; stipules linear or ovate, 4–9 by 1.5–3 mm, reddish brown woolly outside, glabrous inside, caducous. Flowers 3–5 in axils of leaves, slightly below apex of branchlets; pedicels angular, 1.8–2.1 cm long, dark brown woolly-puberulous. Sepals 4, both surfaces brown or reddish brown woolly-puberulous except for the basal and central parts inside; outer sepals broadly ovate, somewhat crested, 7.5–8.2 by 4.2–5.8 mm; inner sepals oblong-ovate, crested, 6.8–7.5 by 3.2–4.8 mm, with membranous, glabrous, fimbriate margin. Corolla 1.2–2 cm long, entirely glabrous; tube 4.6–9.3 mm long; lobes 12–14, lanceolate or oblong, 7.6–10 by 2.8–3.2 mm. Stamens 28, 6.5–9 mm long, entirely glabrous; filaments filiform, 2.5–4 mm long; anthers oblong or lanceolate, 4–4.5 mm long; connective 0.6–1.5 mm long. Ovary discoid-globose, 11–14-locular, glabrous; style 2.5–3 cm long, glabrous exserted. Fruits globose, 1–1.3 by 1 cm, glabrous, 1–2-seeded.

description: Tree ca 8 m tall; branchlets angular, glabrous. Leaves scattered; lamina chartaceous, elliptic or elliptic-obovate, 12–18.5 by 3.8–7 cm; apex acute or obtusely acuminate; base cuneate, decurrent; both surfaces glabrous; midrib narrowly crested above, minutely crested, rounded below; secondary veins 11–15 on each side, vanishing near the margin, somewhat looped in apical part of leaf; tertiary veins transverse and reticulately connected or reticulate with some transverse veins; petioles 2–3 cm long, grooved above with minute crests from the midrib, rounded below, slightly thickened at base, sparsely puberulous; stipules ovate-lanceolate, ca 2.5 by 1 mm, puberulous outside, glabrous inside, caducous. Flowers 2–4 in axils of leaves; pedicels terete, 1.5–1.7 cm long, reddish brown puberulous. Sepals 4, broadly ovate or orbicular, 3–4 by 3–4 mm; outer sepals reddish brown or greyish sericeous outside, glabrous inside; inner sepals reddish brown sericeous outside, glabrous inside, with membranous, glabrous, fimbriate margin. Corolla and style unknown. Stamens 12. Ovary 6-locular. Fruits ovoid, 2.5–3 by 1.2–1.5 cm, fleshy, glabrous, 1-seeded. Seed obovoid, laterally flattened, 1.5–2 by 0.7–1 by 0.2–0.6 cm.

description: Tree ca 8 m high; branchlets reddish brown tomentose or glabrescent. Leaves scattered; lamina coriaceous, elliptic or oblong elliptic, (6–) 10–13.5 by 3.5–5 cm; apex acute; base cuneate, decurrent; lower surface of young leaves woolly; both surfaces of mature leaves glabrous; midrib raised, strongly keeled above, rounded below; secondary veins 11–14 on each side, looped in apical part of leaf; tertiary veins transverse and reticulately connected; petioles 1–1.5 cm long, grooved at apex, rounded at base, reddish brown tomentose, glabrescent; stipules unknown. Flowers 4–12 in axils of leaves; pedicels angular, 3.7–5 mm long, reddish brown tomentose. Sepals 4, reddish brown tomentose except for glabrous central and basal part inside; outer sepals broadly elliptic or broadly ovate, 4.3–5 by 3–3.8 mm; inner sepals ovate, 3.7–4 by 2.5–2.8 mm, with membranous, glabrous, fimbriate margin. Corolla (mature) not seen; lobes 8–9, ovate or lanceolate, glabrous except for reddish brown woolly hairs between the stamens. Stamens 15–16; anthers sparsely hairy. Ovary conoid, hirsute in the upper part; style 5.5–6 mm long, glabrous except for a sparsely hirsute base. Fruits obovoid, 20 by 12 by 5 mm, 1-seeded. Seed brown, laterally compressed.
