description: Tree ca 20 m tall; branchlets very stout, reddish brown tomentose or glabrescent, with numerous leaf and flower scars. Leaves mostly spirally tufted at the ends of branchlets; lamina coriaceous, obovate or spathulate, 15.5–19 by 5.4–8 cm; apex obtuse or shortly notched, deflexed; base cuneate, decurrent; upper surface glabrous; lower surface tomentose or glabrescent; midrib grooved above, minutely crested, rounded below; secondary veins 13–16 on each side, vanishing near the margin; tertiary veins reticulate; petioles 2–2.5 mm long, narrowly grooved at apex, rounded and thickened at base, puberulous; stipules lanceolate, 10–11 by 2–3 mm, crested, puberulous outside, glabrous inside, caducous. Flowers numerous together at apex of branchlets; pedicels (1.5–) 3–3.5 cm long, slender, angular, reddish brown tomentose. Sepals 4 (–6), lanceolate-ovate, reddish brown tomentose except for a glabrous basal part inside; outer sepals 9–10 by 5.6–6 mm; inner sepals 9–10 by 6–7 mm, with membranous, glabrous, fimbriate margin. Corolla 1.5–1.6 cm long, glabrous except for woolly hairs between the stamens; tube ca 5 mm long; lobes 15–17, spathulate or oblanceolate, 10–11 by 3–3.3 mm. Stamens 33–35, 6.8–7.5 mm long, entirely glabrous; filaments filiform, 2.7–3.2 mm long; anthers ovate or lanceolate, 3–3.4 mm long; connective acuminate, 0.5–0.8 mm long. Ovary disciform, 15–16-locular, reddish brown tomentose-hirsute; style 2.8–3 cm long, glabrous. Fruits unknown.

description:
Tree to 15 m tall; branchlets angular, sparsely reddish brown puberulous or glabrescent. Leaves scattered; lamina chartaceous or subcoriaceous, elliptic to obovate-elliptic, (12.5–) 14–19 by (4–) 5–7.5 cm; apex acute or obtusely acuminate; base cuneate, decurrent; both surfaces glabrous; midrib grooved, minutely crested above, rounded below; secondary veins 
7–12 on each side, vanishing near the margin, somewhat looped in apical part of leaf; tertiary veins transverse and reticulately connected; petioles 2–3 cm long, grooved and narrowly crested above, rounded below, thickened at base, glabrous; stipules ovate-lanceolate, 4–5 by 1–1.5 mm, reddish brown puberulous outside, glabrous inside, caducous. Flowers 3–8 in axils of leaves of fallen leaves; pedicels angular, 3–6 mm long, brownish sericeous. Sepals 4, brown sericeous outside, glabrous inside; outer sepals ovate to broadly ovate, 4.7–5.4 by 3.5–4.2 mm; inner sepals narrowly ovate to ovate, 4.3–5.3 by 2.5–4.2 mm, with membranous, glabrous, fimbriate margin. Corolla 5.7–6.2 mm long, sparsely hairy on the outside of the tube and along mid-line of the lobes and reddish brown woolly between the stamens: tube ca 2.5 mm long; lobes 8, oblong to oblong-elliptic or lanceolate, 3.2–3.7 by 1.2–1.4 mm. Stamens 16, 3–3.5 mm long; filaments subulate, 0.8–1.2 mm long, reddish brown woolly; anthers oblong, 2–2.5 mm long, sparsely reddish brown hirsute; connective ca 0.2 mm long. Ovary conoid, tapering into the style, 6–7-locular, glabrous; style 5–8 mm long, exserted, glabrous. Fruits (immature) globose or ellipsoid, 7 by 5–7 mm, crowned by style remnant at apex.

description: Tree to 25 m tall; branchlets angular, reddish brown sericeous. Leaves scattered; lamina chartaceous or subcoriaceous, obovate, obovate-oblong, elliptic-ovate, elliptic or oblanceolate, 7–20 by 3–8.5 cm; apex acute, obtusely acuminate or obtuse; base cuneate, somewhat asymmetrical, decurrent; both surfaces glabrous; midrib raised above, rounded below; secondary veins 8–11 on each side, vanishing near the margin, somewhat looped in apical part of leaf; tertiary veins transverse and reticulately connected; petioles 1.5–4 cm long, flat or slightly grooved, minutely crested at apex, thickened at base, glabrous; stipules lanceolate, 2.5–3.5 by 0.8–1 mm, puberulous outside, glabrous inside, crested, caducous. Flowers 3–8 in axils of leaves or fallen leaves; pedicels angular, 7–10 mm long, reddish brown sericeous. Sepals 4, reddish brown sericeous outside, glabrous inside; outer sepals ovate, 5.6–8 by 4–6.6 mm; inner sepals broadly ovate or orbicular, crested, 6.2–8.2 by 6–7 mm, with membranous, glabrous, fimbriate margin. Corolla 8–9 mm long, densely reddish brown sericeous on the outside except along margin of lobes and ultimate base of tube, glabrous inside except tomentose in throat; tube 3–3.3 mm long; lobes 8–10, lanceolate or elliptic-lanceolate, 5–5.7 by 1.1–1.7 mm. Stamens 19–22, 4.4–5 mm long; filaments subulate, ca 0.6 mm long, densely reddish brown hirsute; anthers oblong-ovate, extrorse, ca 3.5 mm long, densely reddish brown hirsute; connective 0.7–1 mm long. Ovary conoid, 10–12-locular, glabrous; style filiform, 6–10 mm long, exserted, glabrous. Fruits oblong-ovoid, 2–2.7 by 1–1.5 cm, crownedby style remnant at apex, 1-seeded.

description: Tree to 35 m tall; branchlets terete, reddish brown puberulous or glabrescent. Leaves scattered; lamina coriaceous, broadly elliptic; apex acuminate, rarely shortly retuse; base broadly cuneate, somewhat asymmetrical, decurrent; both surfaces glabrous; midrib raised, crested above, slightly flat below; secondary veins 10–17 on each side, arched and forming a slender intramarginal vein; tertiary veins reticulate, inconspicuous on both surfaces; petioles 1–3 cm long, flat and crested at apex, rounded and thickened at base, glabrous; stipules triangular, ca 2 by 1 mm, reddish brown sericeous outside, glabrous inside. Flowers 3–15 in axils of leaves; pedicels angular, 1–1.5 cm long, sparsely reddish brown puberulous, glabrescent. description: Tree to 20 m tall; branchlets stout, reddish brown or greyish woolly or glabrescent. description: Tree to 20 m tall; branchlets reddish brown tomentose, glabrescent. description: Tree to 12 m tall; branchlets stout, reddish brown puberulous or glabrescent. description: Tree to 7 m tall; branchlets stout, greyish puberulous, glabrescent. description: Trees or shrubs; branchlets glabrous or pubescent. Leaves spiral, tufted at the ends of branchlets; lamina coriaceous, obovate, oblanceolate or ovate; apex acute or rounded; base cuneate, glabrous or pubescent; secondary venation looped; midrib grooved above, prominent below; secondary veins variable in number; tertiary veins often descending from the margin and parallel to the secondaries, inconspicuous on both surfaces; stipules absent. Flowers solitary or fasciculate, either in axils of leaves or fallen leaves; pedicels pubescent. Calyx of 2 whorls of 3 free or slightly united sepals, the outer whorl valvate. Corolla glabrous; tube much shorter than the corolla lobes or rarely equalling or exceeding them; lobes 6, spreading, usually divided to the base into 3 segments; median segment erect, clasping the stamen; two lateral segments spreading, shorter than the median segment. Stamens 6 in a single whorl inserted at the top of the corolla tube; anthers extrorse; staminodes 6, variable in shape, alternating with the stamens. Disc annular. Ovary 6–12-locular, pubescent; style exserted. Fruits 1–many-seeded, berry. Seed ellipsoid or obovoid, laterally compressed.</br></br>About 75 species in the tropics. Three species indigenous to Thailand and one cultivated.

description: Tree to 6 m tall; branchlets reddish brown puberulous or glabrescent. description: Trees; branchlets pubescent or glabrescent. Leaves spiral, scattered; lamina coriaceous; secondary venation looped; tertiary veins parallel-reticulate to secondary veins and descending from the margin; stipules present, caducous. Flowers bisexual, solitary or fasciculate either in axils of leaves or fallen leaves. Calyx of 2 whorls of 4 free sepals, the outer whorl valvate. Corolla glabrous or pubescent; tube shorter than lobes; lobes 8, divided to the base into 3 segments; median segment slender, usually erect and clasping the stamens, lateral segments spreading, often equalling or slightly exceeding the median segment, entire or deeply divided. Stamens 8, in a single whorl, inserted at the top of corolla tube; filaments free or partially fused to the staminodes; anthers extrorse, glabrous; staminodes 8, well-developed, alternating with the stamens. Ovary 8-locular, pubescent. Fruits 1–6-seeded, indehiscent, fleshy. Seed laterally compressed.</br></br>A genus of 21 species in Africa, Madagasca, Mascarenes and Seychelles. One species in Asia, including Thailand.

description: Tree to 10 m tall; branchlets terete, reddish brown puberulous. Corolla glabrous except for a few hairs on the lower surface outside; tube 1–1.7 mm long; segments 5.3–6.2 by 0.8–1.3 mm; median segment elliptic or lanceolate, with obtuse apex; lateral segments slender, lanceolate, with acute apex. description: Small to large trees; branchlets pubescent or glabrescent. Leaves spiral, scattered or tufted at the ends of branchlets; lamina chartaceous to coriaceous, obovate, oblanceolate, elliptic or oblong; apex acute, acuminate or rounded, base narrowly to broadly cuneate, rarely rounded, glabrous or pubescent; venation arched, rarely looped; midrib grooved, flat or raised above, rounded or keeled below; secondary veins variable in number; tertiary veins transverse, reticulate or parallel-reticulate to the secondary veins; stipules tiny, caducous. Flowers bisexual, in 1–many-flowered fascicles, axillary or in axils of fallen leaves. Calyx of 2 whorls of 3 free or slightly united sepals. Corolla: lobes (4–) 6 (–7), usually contorted; corolla tube usually glabrous, rarely pubescent inside. Stamens 12 (–21), usually in a single whorl, inserted near the top of the corolla tube or at the base of the corolla lobes; filaments free, unequal, those alternating with the corolla lobes very short; anthers sagittate, oblong or ovoid, dorsifixed, nearly always extrorse, apex bifid or acuminate, glabrous or pubescent. Ovary pubescent or glabrous, discoid or conoid, (3–) 6-locular; style simple, filiform, usually long-exserted, glabrous or pubescent at base. Fruits globose, ellipsoid or oblong-ellipsoid, crowned by persistent calyx, 1–2 (–many)-seeded. Seed usually broadly oblong or ellipsoid with a broad adaxial scar.</br></br>About 110 species from the Indo-Sri Lankan region, through SE Asia to the Pacific islands. Ten indigenous species, including two endemic, in Thailand.

description: Tree ca 28 m tall; branchlets terete or subangular, reddish brown puberulous or glabrescent. Leaves mostly spirally tufted at the ends of branchlets; lamina chartaceous or subcoriacoous, elliptic, oblong or oblong-lanceolate, 11–21 by 3.7–8 cm; apex rounded, obtuse or obtusely acuminate; base narrowly cuneate or cuneate, decurrent; both surfaces glabrous; midrib grooved above, somewhat crested, slightly keeled or rounded below; secondary veins 12–21 on each side, vanishing near the margin, looped in apical part of leaf; teriary veins transverse but subparallel to the secondary veins; petioles 1.5–2.5 cm long, grooved, distinctly crested above, angular below, glabrous; stipules lanceolate, 1–1.5 by 0.5 mm, reddish brown puberulous outside, glabrous inside, caducous. Flowers 1–6 in axils of fallen leaves; pedicels angular, 5–20 mm long, reddish brown tomentose. Sepals (4–)6, reddish brown tomentose outside, glabrous inside, with plumulose apex; outer sepals ovate or triangular, 3–3.8 by 2.5–4 mm; inner sepals broadly elliptic or broadly ovate, 3–4 by 2.8–4 mm, crested with membranous, glabrous, fimbriate margin. Corolla 7–12 mm long, entirely glabrous; tube 1.8–3.1 mm long; lobes (4–) 6 (–7), oblong, lanceolate, ovate or elliptic, 5.5–7.5 by 2.7–3.7 mm, with ciliate apex. Stamens (12–) 14–20, 4.5–8.5 mm long, entirely glabrous; filaments filiform, 2.5–4 mm long; anthers narrowly oblong-ovoid or sagittate, extrorse, 2.5–4 mm long, sparsely hairy; connective truncate, acute or aristate, 0.1–0.4 mm long. Ovary conoid, 5–6-locular, 6-lobed, reddish brown tomentose; style exserted, 6-ribbed, 8.5–16 mm long, glabrous except for a thinly tomentose basal part (according to Royen entirely glabrous); stigma 6-lobed. Fruits unknown.

description: Tree ca 3 m tall; branchlets terete, reddish brown puberulous or glabrescent. Leaves scattered; lamina chartaceous or coriaceous, obovate, elliptic, oblong-elliptic or broadly elliptic, (6–) 10–21.5 by (2.4–) 4–8.5 cm; apex obtusely acuminate or acute; base cuneate, decurrent; both surfaces glabrous except for a sparsely hairy midrib; midrib raised or crested above except for a flat lower part; rounded below; secondary veins 6–12 on each side; tertiary veins transverse; petioles 5–12 mm long, grooved in the apical part, rounded and thickened in the basal part, reddish brown puberulous, glabrescent, stipules unknown. Flowers 3–10 in axils of apical leaves; pedicels angular, 2–4 mm long, reddish brown tomentose. Sepals 6, reddish brown tomentose outside, glabrous except for tomentose apical part, with membranous, glabrous, fimbriate margin; outer sepals ovate to broadly ovate, 2.5–4 by 1.8–2.5 mm; inner sepals ovate to broadly ovate 2.7–3.7 by 1.8–2.5 mm. Corolla 5–6.3 mm long, glabrous except for a few hairs at the apex of the lobes; tube 2–3.8 mm long; lobes 6, oblong, 2.7–3 by 0.8–1.3 mm. Ovary conoid, 3–4-locular, 3–4-angular, tapering into a style, the upper part hirsute, the lower part glabrous; style ribbed, 2.2–2.8 mm long, not exserted, glabrous except for a sparsely hirsute base. description: Tree to 22 m tall; branchlets terete, pale or brown yellowish woolly or glabrescent. Leaves mostly spirally tufted at the ends of branchlets; lamina coriaceous, ovate or ovate-oblong, 10–20 by 6–11.5 cm; apex obtuse or short obtusely acuminate, with acumen to 1.5 cm long; base broadly cuneate to rounded, somewhat asymmetrical; upper surface glabrous or woolly near the base; lower surface reddish brown woolly, dense on midrib and veins; midrib grooved above, often with a narrow groove in the middle of larger groove, somewhat woolly, rounded below; secondary veins 20–26 on each side, looped; tertiary veins transverse; petioles 2.5–3 cm long, narrowly grooved above, densely yellowish or brownish woolly; stipules lanceolate, 7–12 by 3–5 mm, pale or yellowish brown woolly outside, sparsely reddish brown woolly inside. Sepals 6, not folded, reddish brown tomentose outside, glabrous inside; outer sepals broadly ovate or triangular, 5–5.6 by 4–5 mm; inner sepals ovate, oblong-ovoid or triangular, 4–4.5 by 3–4 mm, with membranous, glabrous, fimbriate margin. Corolla 9–12 mm long, glabrous except for reddish brown sericeous on the tube and the lobe base outside; tube 2–3 mm long; lobes 6, broadly elliptic, ovate or obovate, 7.5–8.2 by 3.5–3.8 mm. Ovary conoid, 6-locular, yellowish or brownish hirsute; style angular, 1.5–1.7 cm long, exserted, glabrous. Fruits globose or ellipsoid, brownish, 1.5–2 by 1.5 cm, with short style remnant.

description: Tree to 30 m tall; branchlets terete, reddish brown puberulous, glabrescent. Flowers 4–10 in axils of leaves; pedicels angular, 6–8 mm long, reddish brown tomentose. description: Tree to 35 m tall; branchlets terete or angular, puberulous, glabrescent. Leaves scattered or mostly at apex of branchlets; lamina coriaceous, obovate, obovate-oblong or oblong, 13–29 by 5.5–14.7 cm; apex acute, obtusely acuminate or obtuse, rarely retuse; base narrowly to broadly cuneate, decurrent; upper surface glabrous or with sparse short appressed hairs, lower surface with sparse short appressed hairs; midrib grooved, minutely crested above, rounded below; secondary veins 7–14 on each side, vanishing near margin, looped in apical part of leaf; tertiary veins, transverse; petioles 1.5–3.5 cm long, grooved or flat in the apical half, rounded in the basal part, puberulous, glabrescent; stipules lanceolate or linear, 4–10 by 1.5 mm, puberulous outside, glabrous inside, caducous. Sepals 6, reddish brown tomemtose outside, glabrous inside; outer sepals triangular or broadly ovate, 2.7–4.5 by 2.8–4 mm; inner sepals orbicular or ovate, 3.5–4.1 by 3.5–4 mm, crested, with membranous, glabrous, fimbriate margin. Corolla 1.2–1.4 cm long, entirely glabrous; tube 5 mm long; lobes 6, lanceolate-oblong, 7.5–8.2 by 2.7–3.2 mm. Stamens 12, 6.5–7.5 mm long; filaments filiform, 5 mm long, glabrous; anthers sagittate, ovate or oblong-ovoid, extrorse, 3.5–4 mm long, reddish brown sericeous; connective acuminate, 0.2–0.3 mm long. Ovary conoid, 6-locular, 12-lobed, glabrous; style 2–2.8 cm long, exserted, glabrous. Fruits pruniform to globose or obpyriform, to 2.8 by 2.2 cm, 1–2-seeded. Seeds ellipsoid, ca 2.5 by 1.2 by 1 cm, laterally compressed.

description: Tree to 30 m tall; branchlets terete, yellowish woolly or glabrescent. Leaves mostly at apex of branchlets; lamina coriaceous, elliptic, obovate or oblong, 15.5–21.5 by 6.4–11 cm; apex rounded or retuse; base broadly cuneate or rounded; upper surface glabrous or yellowish woolly along midrib only; lower surface woolly, denser on midrib and veins; midrib grooved and minutely crested above; secondary veins 19–22 on each side, vanishing near the margin; tertiary veins transverse; petioles 1.5–2.5 cm long, flat above with shallow groove, yellowish woolly, rounded below; stipules lanceolate, ca 13 by 4 mm, woolly outside, glabrous inside, caducous. Flowers 7–16 in axils of fallen leaves; pedicels angular 2–2.2 cm long, yellowish or brownish woolly. Sepals 3-folded, ovate or obovate-oblong, 4–5 by 4–5 mm, yellowish or brownish woolly outside, glabrous inside, rim of the inner sepals membranous and glabrous. Corolla 1.2–1.6 cm long, glabrous except for brownish or yellowish woolly V-shaped patch towards the base outside, with glabrous margin; lobes 6, elliptic-oblong, 11–13.5 by 2.5–3.5 mm. description: Tree to 30 m tall; branchlets terete or angular, greyish puberulous or glabrescent. Leaves scattered or mostly at apex of branchlets; lamina coriaceous, obovate, 10–11 by 4.8–6 cm; apex rounded, obtuse or retuse; base cuneate, decurrent; both surfaces glabrous; midrib flat or slightly grooved above, somewhat minutely crested, keeled below; secondary veins 16–20 on each side, arched, hardly distinguished from the tertiary veins; tertiary veins parallel-reticulate; petioles 2.5–3 cm long, flat and crested above, angular below, puberulous; stipules lanceolate, ca 1 by 0.5 mm, puberulous outside, glabrous inside, caducous. Flowers 2–6 in axils of fallen leaves; pedicels angular, 5–7 mm long, reddish brown tomentose. Sepals 6, reddish brown tomentose outside, glabrous inside; outer sepals triangular or broadly ovate, 4–4.7 by 3.5–4.4 mm, slightly crested; inner sepals ovate, 4.3–4.5 by 2.7–3 mm, crested, with membranous, glabrous, fimbriate margin. Corolla 6.8–7.5 mm long, glabrous except sparsely reddish brown sericeous on the corolla base and along the mid-line of the lobes outside, reddish brown woolly in the throat; tube 1.8–2 mm long; lobes 6, oblong-ovoid, 5–5.5 by 2.1–2.5 mm. Stamens 12, 4.3–4.7 mm long; filaments filiform, 0.3–0.5 mm long, reddish brown woolly, glabrescent; anthers ovoid, extrorse, 2.2–2.5 mm long, brown woolly, glabrescent; connective bifid, 0.2–0.4 mm long, glabrous. description: Tree ca 25 m tall; branchlets obtusely angular or terete, reddish brown puberulous, glabrescent. Leaves mostly spirally tufted at the ends of branchlets; lamina coriaceous, obovate, 10.5–13.5 by 4.5–7 cm; apex obtusely acuminate; base cuneate, decurrent; both surfaces sericeous; midrib grooved above, but raised near the apex, rounded below; secondary veins 9–12 on each side, vanishing near the margin, looped in apical part of leaf; tertiary veins reticulate or subparallel to the secondary veins; petioles 2–2.5 cm long, grooved above, rounded below, sericeous; stipules lanceolate ca 2.5 by 0.6 mm, reddish brown tomentose outside, glabrous inside, caducous. Flowers 4–8 in axils of leaves; pedicels angular, 6 mm long, sericeous. Sepals 6, densely tomentose outside, glabrous inside except for sericeous central and basal parts; outer sepals ovate or oblong-ovate, 4.2–4.8 by 2.7–3 mm; inner sepals ovate-lanceolate, 4.2–4.8 by 2.7–3 mm, with membranous, glabrous, fimbriate margin. Corolla 6–7 mm long, glabrous except reddish brown woolly between the stamens (according to Royen entirely glabrous); lobes 6, oblong, 5–5.3 by 1.3–1.5 mm; apex fimbriate. Stamens 12; filaments hirsute; anthers sparsely hirsute, mainly at base; connective bifid. Ovary discoid, 6-locular, hirsute; style 7–9 mm long, glabrous. Fruits unknown.

description:
Tree to 45 m tall (fide Royen); branchlets terete, greyish or reddish brown puberulous, glabrescent. Leaves scattered; lamina, coriaceous, oblanceolate or obovate, 14–18 by 5.5–6.5 cm; apex obtusely acuminate; base cuneate, decurrent; both surfaces glabrous; midrib flat or crested above, strongly keeled below; secondary veins 23–25 on each side, arched; tertiary 
veins parallel-reticulate; petioles 2.5–3 cm, flat but narrowly grooved above, rounded below, thickened in the basal half, reddish brown puberulous, glabrescent; stipules lanceolate, 5–6 by 2 mm, puberulous outside, glabrous inside, caducous. Flowers in 2–4 in axils of fallen leaves; pedicels angular, 6–10 mm long, reddish brown tomentose. Sepals 6, reddish brown tomentose outside, glabrous inside; outer sepals broadly ovate, 4.3–4.7 by 3.5–3.8 mm; inner sepals ovate or triangular, 4.7–4.9 by 3–3.3 mm, crested, with membranous, glabrous, fimbriate margin. Corolla 8.4–10 mm long, glabrous except reddish brown pubescent along mid-line of the lobes outside; tube 2.2–2.5 mm long; lobes 6, ovate or elliptic, 6.2–7.5 by 2.8–3.2 mm. Stamens 12, 4.7–5 mm long, entirely glabrous; filaments filiform, 2.7–3 mm long; anthers oblong-ovoid, extrorse, 2.5–2.8 mm long; connective acuminate, 0.2–0.4 mm long. Ovary discoid, 6-locular, reddish brown tomentose; style ca 9 mm long, exserted, ribbed, glabrous except for a tomentose base; stigma 6-lobed. Fruits not seen.

description:
Trees; branchlets pubescent or glabrescent. Leaves alternate and distichous, scattered; lamina chartaceous to coriaceous, elliptic, ovate, obovate or lanceolate; apex acute or acuminate; base cuneate, glabuous or pubescent; venation looped; midrib grooved or raised above and crested, rounded below; secondary veins variable in number; tertiary venation 
parallel-reticulate to the secondary veins; stipules present, caducous. Flower bisexual, in axillary fascicles. Calyx of 2 whorls of 2 more or less free sepals. Corolla lobes 8, imbricate, equal to or longer than the corolla tube; tube usually glabrous inside. Stamens 16, inserted in 1 (–2) whorls at the top of the corolla tube; anthers extrorse or latrorse. Ovary pubescent (6–) 8-locular, style exserted, tapering gradually to the apex. Fruits 1–2-seeded. Seed laterally compressed, with a long narrow adaxial scar.</br></br>About 15 species in mainland SE Asia and Malesia. Four species native in Thailand.

description: Tree to 25 m tall; branchlets appressed sericeous pubescent. Leaves chartaceous to coriaceous, elliptic, ovate or obovate, 10.5–14.5 by 3.5–6.5 cm; apex acute or acuminate; base broadly or narrowly cuneate; upper surface glabrous; lower surface reddish brown pubescent; midrib raised above; secondary veins 11–15 on each side; tertiary veins inconspicuous on both surfaces; petioles 1–1.6 cm long, sericeous glabrescent. Flowers 4–8 in axils of leaves; pedicels 1–1.2 cm long, minutely glabrescent. Outer sepals broadly ovate, 5.6–6.5 by 4–4.5 mm, sericeous outside, sparsely sericeous inside; inner sepals ovate, crested, 5.3–5.6 by 3.8–4.5 mm, sericeous outside, glabrous inside, with fimbriate margin. Corolla 6.5–7.5 mm long, glabrous tube 2.3–2.5 mm long; lobes elliptic-oblong, 4.3–4.8 by 1.8–2.2 mm. Stamens 3.5–4 mm long; filaments filiform, 1.3–1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ovate, oblong or elliptic, extrorse, 1.5–1.8 mm long; connective linear or acute, 0.8–1.3 by 0.2–0.4 mm. Ovary conical, 8-locular, reddish brown hirsute; style 8–9 mm long, glabrous except for a reddish brown hirsute base. Fruits ovoid to obovate, ca 3 by 1.5 cm, subglabrous to glabrous, 1–2-seeded.

description: Tree to 35 m tall; branchlets terete or angular, reddish brown tomentose or glabrescent. Leaves lanceolate or lanceolate-oblong, 9.5–14.5 by 2.2–5 cm; apex obtusely acuminate; base broadly cuneate or rounded, asymmetrical; both surfaces glabrous, somewhat reddish brown tomentose near the base or along midrib on the lower surface; midrib grooved above, reddish brown tomentose, glabrescent; stipules long acute, reddish brown pubescent, 4–5 mm long. Flowers 3–8 either in axils of leaves or fallen leaves; pedicels 9–11 mm long, reddish brown tomentose. Outer sepals broadly ovate or triangular, 3.8–4.6 by 3.7–4.5 mm, reddish brown tomentose outside except for glabrous central and basal parts inside; inner sepals ovate or oblong, 3.7–4.6 by 3–4.5 mm, reddish brown tomentose outside, glabrous inside. Corolla 6–9 mm long, glabrous, rarely pubescent on the outside of the tube and corolla lobes; tube 2–3.2 mm long; lobes broadly ovate-lanceolate or oblong, 4.5–7 by 1.2–3 mm. Stamens 3–3.5 mm long; filaments 0.6–1 mm long, sparsely hairy; anthers sagittate, 2.2–3.2 mm long, with a few hairs on the back; connective 0.2–0.7 mm long, with hairs. Ovary 6–8-locular; style 1–1.3 cm long, glabrous except for a pubescent base. Fruits ovoid, 3–4.5 by 1–2.5 cm, with a long apical beak, reddish brown puberulous.

description: Tree to 40 m tall; branchlets terete, densely reddish brown puberulous or glabrescent. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic-lanceolate or ovate, (7.9–) 10.5–17.5 by (2.4–) 3–6 cm; apex acuminate; base cuneate; upper surface glabrous; lower surface reddish brown pubescent to glabrous, especially along the midrib and secondary veins; midrib grooved above; secondary veins 12–22 on each side; tertiary veins inconspicuous on both surfaces; petioles 1–3 cm long, reddish brown puberulous or glabrescent. Flowers 2–8 either in axils of leaves or fallen leaves; pedicels 8–19 mm long, pubescent. Outer sepals broadly ovate or deltoid, sometimes more or less orbicular, 4.6–6.5 by 4.5–6.7 mm, reddish brown puberulous outside except for glabrous central and basal parts inside, inside glabrous, with slightly membranous margin; inner sepals broadly ovate, 4.5–6.5 by 4.2–5.5 mm, reddish brown sericeous outside, glabrous inside, with membranous, glabrous, fimbriate margin. Corolla 6–11 mm long, glabrous outside, rarely with reddish brown tomentose on the tube and lobes, pubescent between the stamens; tube 2.2–5 mm long; lobes oblong or lanceolate, 4–6 by 1.7–3.5 mm. Stamens 2.8–3.8 mm long; filaments 0.6–1.2 mm long, pubescent; anthers oblong-ovoid, 2.2–3.5 mm long, rarely sparsely hairy; connective mucronate, 0.3–1 mm long. Ovary 7–8-locular, inside hirsute; style 1–1.5 cm long, glabrous. Fruits globose or ellipsoid, reddish brown puberulous.

description: Tree to 30 m tall; branchlets reddish brown puberulous. Leaves chartaceous, oblanceolate or elliptic-oblong, 11–16.5 by 3.5–5 cm; apex acuminate; base cuneate; upper surface glabrous; lower surface reddish brown sericeous; midrib raised, crested above, rounded, prominent below; secondary veins 17–18 on each side; tertiary veins slightly conspicuous above, inconspicuous below; petioles 2–2.7 cm long, reddish brown puberulous. Flowers 4–7 in axils of leaves; pedicels angular, 1.5–2 cm long, reddish brown puberulous. Outer sepals ovate, 8.5–9 by 6.5–7 mm, crested, reddish brown sericeous except for glabrous central part inside; inner sepals ovate, 8.5–8.7 by 6–6.3 mm, crested, reddish brown sericeous outside, glabrous inside, with fimbriate margin. Corolla 1.3–1.5 cm long, glabrous; tube 4.3–5 mm long; lobes lanceolate, 9–10 by 3–3.5 mm. Stamens 4.3–5 mm long, glabrous; filaments subulate 1.6–2 mm long. Ovary 8-locular, reddish brown hirsute; style 1.8–2.2 cm long, glabrous except for reddish brown tomentose lower half. Fruits oblong to ellipsoid, 2.5–3.5 by 1.5–2 cm, reddish brown puberulous, 1 (–2)-seeded.

description: Shrubs or small trees, coastal; all parts appressed grey hairy. Leaves opposite, (sub)sessile. Flowers axillary, solitary (or paired), 6-merous, actinomorphic, distylic; calyx tube (narrowly) campanulate; calyx lobes (sepals) short; epicalyx appendages about half as long as calyx lobes; petals white; stamens 12, ± biseriate, inserted somewhat above base of calyx tube tube, 6 exserted in short-styled flowers, all included in long-styled flowers; ovary globose, 1-locular with central basal placentation. Capsule dry, opening operculate, slightly exserted from calyx. Seeds irregularly obpyramidal, not winged.</br></br>A single coastal species, in E Africa, and in S and SE Asia east to the Marshall Islands in the Pacific Ocean, north to Japan (Ryukyu Islands).

description: Shrubs or densely branched trees (0.5–)1–5 m tall, base of trunk to 10 cm diam. Leaves decussate; petiole to 2 mm long; lamina narrowly elliptic to lanceolate, 10–30 by 3–15 mm, thick, succulent, base attenuate, apex acute or obtuse, often terminating in a minute hydathode. Flowers axillary; bracteoles 2, minute, at base of pedicel 5–15 mm long; calyx tube 4–6 mm long, finely 12-ridged, thick-walled; calyx lobes short, about one-quarter as long as calyx tube; epicalyx appendages ca half as long; petals elliptic, or (ob)ovate or suborbicular, 5–8 by 3–5 mm, crumpled in bud; stamens 12, scarcely biseriate, 6 exserted in short-styled flowers, or all included in long-styled flowers; style long-exserted or included, stigma broad capitate. Capsule 1-locular (incompletely 3-locular), subglobose or obovoid, 6–9 mm long, somewhat exserted at maturity. Seeds ca 20, with one thickish margin, not winged, 2–3 mm long.

description: Delicate, perennial, unbranched or few-branched decumbent herb. Leaves alternate, petiolate; blades ovate, margin sinuate-dentate, apex subacute. Flowers small, white or pale pinkish, solitary, axillary or terminal; pedicel long, slender, erect; calyx lobes long-triangular; corolla regular, campanulate, deeply 5-lobed, lobes sublinear, apex subobtuse; stamens 5, filaments linear, free; anthers linear; style slender, stigma with 3 recurved lobes; ovary (2–)3-locular. Fruit a thin-walled, membranous capsule, slightly contracted at apex, few-seeded, rupturing irregularly. Seeds comparatively large, oblong.</br></br>The genus comprises one species, endemic to eastern Asia.

description: Herb 5–25 cm long, often rooting at lower nodes; stem glabrous or pubescent. Leaves: petiole 0.2–1.5 cm long; blade somewhat fleshy, glabrous or hairy, ovate, 0.5–3.5 by 0.5–2.5 cm, base (sub)truncate(cordate), margin serrulate or crenulate with 2–10 teeth per side, apex acute or rounded. Flowers solitary, axillary, rarely few-fascicled; pedicel slender, to 50 mm long; braceoles absent; calyx lobes 1–2 by 0.5–1 mm, margin entire; corolla white, rarely with purple shading at the tips, campanulate, 5–10 mm long, deeply 5-lobed, tube 1(–4) mm long, lobes sublinear, 1–6 mm long, apex subobtuse; ovary glabrous, 5-ribbed, 2–3.5 by 0.5–2.5 mm, (2–)3-locular, style inserted on a thin, hemispherical, nectariferous disc on top of the ovary, included, 3–6.5 mm long, hairy in upper third, stigma consisting of (2– or) 3 filiform lobes; filaments subglabrous, 1.5–3 mm long, widest and hairy towards the base, anthers 1–1.5 mm long. Capsule nodding, distended by the mature seeds. Seeds 10–16 per capsule, 1–2 mm long, finely striate.

description: Trees or shrubs; branchlets pubescent or glabrescent. Leaves spiral, scattered; lamina chartaceous to coriaceous, obovate or elliptic; apex acute, obtuse or obtusely acuminate; base narrowly to broadly cuneate, glabrous or pubescent; venation arched, rarely looped; midrib grooved, flat or slightly raised above, rounded below; secondary veins variable in number; tertiary venation transverse or parallel-reticulate to the secondary veins; stipules absent. Inflorescence axillary, fasciculate, either in axils of leaves or of fallen leaves. Flowers bisexual or both bisexual and pistillate. Calyx a single whorl of 5 free united quincuncial sepals. Corolla tubular, glabrous; tube shorter than or rarely exceeding the lobes; lobes 5, ± erect. Stamens 5, fixed in the upper half of the corolla tube, included, glabrous; filaments short; anthers ovoid, extrorse, basifixed or dorsifixed. Staminodes 5, glabrous. Ovary conoid or globose, 5-locular, pubescent; style exserted short; stigma inconspicuous or lobed. Fruits globose, ovoid or subovoid.</br></br>About 325 pantropical species. Five native species and one introduced in Thailand. Triono et al. (A phylogeny of Pouteria (Sapotaceae) from Malesia and Australasia. Australian Systematic Botany 20: 107-118. 2007) concluded that it might be possible to classify some species of Pouteria in Planchonella Pierre but the evidence was not strong so, in this account, Pouteria is used in the sense of Pennington (Gen. Sapot. 1991).

description: Tree ca 20 m tall; branchlets terete, reddish brown sericeous or glabrescent. Leaves coriaceous, oblanceolate or elliptic, 20–40 by 2.8–5.8 cm; apex narrowly attenuate to broadly acute or obtuse, base narrowly attenuate, margin entire; upper surface glabrous, shining; lower surface minutely appressed puberulous to glabrescent; midrib raised above; secondary veins 12–18 on each side, vanishing near the margin; tertiary veins transverse; marginal vein present; petioles 2.5–3 cm long, raised above, subglabrous. Flowers bisexual, solitary or many-flowered in clusters; pedicels angular, 1.5–2.2 cm long, appressed puberulous. Sepals ovate, rounded, 2.5–5 mm long, both sides puberulous, sometimes ciliate. Corolla 4–6 mm long; tube 1.5–2 mm long; lobes broadly elliptic to suborbicular, 2.5–4 mm long, apex rounded, glabrous. Stamens 1.7–2 mm long; filaments 0.1–0.2 mm long, glabrous; anthers lanceolate, 1.5–2 mm long, glabrous; staminodes lanceolate with a narrowly attenuate apex, ca 2 mm long. Ovary broadly conical, strongly and irregularly longitudinally ribbed, puberulous; style 0–1 mm long, after anthesis glabrous; stigma discoid to capitate. Fruits ellipsoid, slightly asymmetrical, apex acute, base obtuse or rounded, smooth or finely lenticellate, glabrous, 1.5–1.8 cm long, yellowish. Seed ellipsoid, obtuse at base and apex, ca 1.3 cm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Tree ca 15 m tall; branchlets terete or angular, reddish brown sericeous or glabrescent. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic-oblong or obovate-oblong, 9–14.5 by 3–4.5 cm; apex acute, rarely obtuse or retuse; base cuneate, asymmetrical, decurrent; upper surface glabrous; lower surface reddish brown sericeous, glabrescent except for a few scattered hairs along midrib and veins; midrib grooved above and minutely crested; secondary veins 10–14 on each side, vanishing near the margin; tertiary veins transverse; petioles 2–3.5 cm long, grooved above, thickened in the basal part, reddish brown puberulous or glabrescent. Flowers bisexual and pistillate, 3–5 in clusters; pistillate flowers smaller than bisexual flowers; pedicels angular, 6–8 mm long, reddish brown tomentose. Sepals triangular or broadly ovate, 2.5–3.2 by 1.4–2.5 mm, both sides reddish brown tomentose, margin of the inner ones membranous. Corolla 4.3–5 mm long; tube 2–3 mm long; lobes subquadrangular, 2.3–2.5 by 1.7–2 mm. Stamens 1.7–2 mm long; filaments subulate, 0.8–1 mm long; anthers ovoid, ca 1 mm long, dorsifixed; staminodes lanceolate, spathulate or oblong, 1.2–1.5 by 0.3–0.4 mm. Ovary conoid or globose, reddish brown hirsute; style angular, 2.5–2.8 mm long, glabrous; stigma 5-lobed. Fruits ovoid or subovoid, 0.8–20 by 12–15 by 7–8 mm, glabrous except at base, black, pericarp thin, chartaceous. Seed light brown, ca 15 by 10 by 7 mm.

description: Tree to 30 m tall; branchlets angular, sparsely puberulous or glabrescent. Leaves chartaceous or subcoriaceous, obovate-oblong, 19–34 by 9–11 cm; apex obtusely acuminate or obtuse; base cuneate, decurrent; both surfaces glabrous; midrib flat or slightly raised; secondary veins 8–14 on each side, vanishing near the margin; tertiary veins arallel or subtransverse; petioles 2.5–4 cm long, flat above, rounded at base, reddish, glabrous. Flowers bisexual, 3–10 in clusters; pedicels terete or angular, 2–3 mm long, tomentose. Sepals 5, broadly ovate or more or less orbicular, 2–3.2 by 2–3 mm, outside of outer ones yellowish tomentose, glabrous inside; outside of the inner ones yellowish in the middle only. Corolla ca 2.5 mm long; tube 1–1.2 mm long; lobes obovate-oblong, 1.2–1.3 by 1–1.3 mm. Stamens 1–1.3 mm long; filaments slender, 0.4–0.6 mm long; anthers ovate, basifixed, 0.5–0.6 mm long; staminodes linear, 0.6 by 0.1–0.2 mm. Ovary conoid, yellowish tomentose; style stout, 1.5–2 mm long, glabrous; stigma inconspicuous. Fruits not seen.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Tree ca 25 m tall; branchlets terete, reddish brown tomentose or glabrescent. Leaves chartaceous to thinly coriaceous, narrowly obovate or broadly obovate, 13.5–17.5 by 4.5–8 cm; apex acute; base cuneate, decurrent; upper surface glabrous; lower surface reddish brown tomentose, glabrescent, glaucous, easily rubbed off; midrib flat or grooved above, minutely crested; secondary veins 7–13 on each side, vanishing near the margin, looped in apical part of leaf; tertiary veins transverse and reticulately connected; petioles 2–3 cm long, flat above, thickened at base, reddish brown tomentose or glabrescent. Flowers bisexual, 6–10 in clusters; pedicels angular, 2–4 mm long, reddish brown tomentose. Sepals broadly ovate, 2.2–3 by 2–2.5 mm, reddish brown tomentose outside, glabrous inside, with fimbriate apex; margin of the inner ones membranous. Corolla 2.5–2.8 mm long; tube 1.8–2 mm long, longer than lobes; lobes lanceolate or ovate, 0.8–1 by 0.5–0.8 mm. Stamens 1–1.2 mm long; filaments 0.5–0.7 mm long; anthers ovate, ca 0.5 mm long, dorsifixed; staminodes spathulate or oblanceolate, 0.5–0.8 by 0.1–0.3 mm. Ovary globose, reddish brown tomentose; style 1.7–2 mm long, glabrous; stigma minute. Fruits more or less globose, 2–3.5 by 1.5–2.5 by 1.5–2.5 cm when dry, 2–3-seeded, densely reddish brown puberulous or glabrescent.

description: Tree to 20 m tall; branchlets terete, reddish brown puberulous or glabrescent. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic, ovate, obovate or lanceolate, 6.5–16.5 by 2–7 cm; apex acute to obtuse; base cuneate, decurrent; upper surface glossy, sparsely hairy, glabrescent; lower surface reddish brown or greyish puberulous or glabrescent; midrib flat above somewhat minutely crested; secondary veins 7–13 on each side, vanishing near the margin, looped in apical part of leaf; tertiary veins reticulate but with one vein more distinct and parallel to the secondary veins; petioles 1–2.5 cm long, flat above, reddish brown or blackish puberulous or glabrescent. Flowers bisexual and pistillate, 4–10 in clusters; the bisexual flowers larger than the pistillate flowers; pedicels terete, 2–4 mm long, reddish brown puberulous. Sepals semiorbicular or orbicular, 1.8–2.5 by 2.2–2.5 mm, the outer ones blackish or yellowish puberulous outside, glabrous inside; the inner ones yellowish puberulous outside, glabrous inside, with membranous fimbriate margin. Corolla 3–3.2 mm long, exserted from the calyx in the bisexual flowers, not exserted in the pistillate flowers; tube 0.8–1.2 mm long; lobes broadly ovate or oblanceolate, 1.5–2 by 1.5–2 mm. Stamens ca 2.5 mm long; filaments filiform, 1.5–1.7 mm long; anthers ovate, 0.8–1 mm long, basifixed; staminodes variable in shape, triangular, lanceolate or tri-dentate 1.2–1.5 by 0.6–1 mm. Ovary conoid, reddish tomentose; style very short, 1.2–1.3 mm long; stigma capitate. Fruits dull dark green, ripening purple, obovoid or subglobose, 1–1.5 by 1–1.5 by 1.5–2.5 cm, 2–5-lobed, 1–5-seeded, pericarp membranous, glabrous.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Tree to 35 m tall; branchlets terete, densely brown tomentose or glabrescent. Leaves subcoriaceous, obovate, (12–) 18–19 (–24) by 6–11 cm; apex acute; base cuneate, entire; upper surface sparsely hairy, glabrescent; lower surface pale green, glabrescent; midrib sunken above; secondary veins 7–9 on each side, vanishing near the margin; tertiary veins reticulate, distinct; petioles 1.5–3.5 cm long, puberulous or glabrescent. Flowers 10–14 in clusters; bracts at base of the pedicels brown hirsute, ca 1 mm long; pedicels 2.5–3 mm long, light brown, puberulous. Sepals suborbicular, obtuse, 2.5–3 mm diam., outside pale green and finely brown pilose, glabrous inside. Corolla 3–4 mm long; glabrous, pale green or white; tube ca 3 mm long; lobes ligulate, apex truncate, minutely erose, ca 1.5 mm long. Stamens ca 1.5 mm long; filaments filiform, 1–1.5 mm long; anthers ovate, ca 1 mm long; staminodes subulate, glabrous, 1.5–2 mm long. Ovary depressed globose, densely brown velutinous, shallowly 5-lobed and 5-locular; style ca 2 mm long; stigma minute, glabrous. Fruits light green, ripening dark red, depressed globose, 24–28 by 28–30 mm when fresh, 19–21 by 19–22 mm when dry, deeply 5-lobed, 5-seeded, pericarp 4 mm thick when fresh, sour (fide Maxwell).
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Shrubs or small trees; branchlets often terminating in spines. Leaves (sub)opposite, sometimes crowded, entire; stipules absent. Flowers (sub)sessile, solitary (or 2), (sub)terminal or axillary, sometimes a few clustered, actinomorphic, bisexual; bracteoles 2, minute; calyx tube glabrous, long cup-shaped, thick-leathery, adnate to ovary and produced above it; calyx lobes (sepals) 5–9, thick, valvate, persistent; petals red, large, crumpled in bud; stamens numerous, caducous, inserted in several rows within thickened calyx tube above ovary, anthers small; ovary (largely) inferior, 6–13-loculed, in 2 or 3 superposed layers, placentation various with numerous ovules, style exserted, stigma capitate. Fruit berry-like, with leathery rind, crowned by persistent calyx lobes, irregularly dehiscent. Seeds not winged, many, angular, with translucent juicy sarcotesta; cotelydons convolute.</br></br>Two species, one endemic to Socotra (Indian Ocean), one native probably in C and SW Asia, at present widely cultivated.

description: Shrub to 5 m tall, glabrous; branchlets 4-angled, becoming terete with age, often terminating as spines. Leaves: petiole 0.1–0.7 cm long; lamina shiny above, lanceolate, elliptic-oblanceolate, or oblong, 2–9 by 1–2 cm, base attenuate, apex obtuse, mucronate. Flowers: calyx tube orange-red (yellow), campanulate-urceolate, 20–35 by 10–15 mm; calyx lobes (5–)6(–9), long-triangular, 10–12 mm long, erect; petals 5–9, red (or white), obovate, not clawed, 15–30 by (5–)10–20 mm, apex obtuse, caducous; stamens numerous, included or exserted; ovary 8–13-loculed. Fruit a globose leathery berry, red or yellow-green or red-brown, 5–12 cm diam. Seeds horny, obpyramidal within juicy (pale) red sarcotesta.

description: Herbs amphibious or terrestrial, annual or perennial, glabrous. Stem erect or ascending, or floating. Leaves decussate, whorled or rarely alternate, sessile or short-petiolate. Bracts leaf-like or scale-like; bracteoles 2 or absent. Flowers sometimes heterostylous (not in Thailand), sessile, solitary in the axils of bracts along the main axis or in lateral or terminal racemes; calyx tube campanulate, enclosing the ovary, calyx lobes 3–6, valvate, persistent, tooth-like calyx appendages or small folds sometimes present between the calyx lobes; nectaries often present at the base of the calyx tube; petals 0–6, minute or large and showy, usually crumpled in bud; stamens 1–6, episepalous, inserted in the calyx tube in the lower half, anthers dorsifixed, introrse; ovary superior, 2–4-locular, placentation axile becoming free-central at maturity, stigma capitate (or 2-lobed, India). Fruit a septicidally dehiscent capsule opening by 2–4 valves, the valves with microscopic horizontal striations; one valve crowned by the persistent style. Seeds numerous or few, semi-ovoid or ellipsoid, with mucilaginous hairs.</br></br>Worldwide ca 45 species, mainly (sub)tropical. One species in Australia, 24 species in Asia; in Thailand 6 species, and two more species to be expected (see key); none endemic.

description: Herbs, amphibious or terrestrial, annual. Stems erect, branched or simple, to 50 cm tall, with 4 distinct white wings running into the leaf or bract margins. Leaves decussate, sessile; lamina lanceolate to ovate or oblong, to 25 mm long, cordate at base, subobtuse at apex. Bracts on main stem like foliage leaves, bracts on lateral inflorescences lanceolate or oblong, spreading or recurved, cordate at base, 2–3 times as long as subtended flower; bracteoles 2, minute, ca 0.2 mm long. Flowers subsessile, usually borne on contracted lateral branches or occasionally on the main stem; calyx tube campanulate, becoming subglobose in fruit, 1–1.5 mm long; calyx lobes 4, triangular, 0.5 mm long, acuminate, usually minutely toothed at margin; calyx appendages absent; petals pink or purple, obovate, equalling or to twice as long as calyx lobes, persistent in fruit; stamens 4, inserted at about one-third up the calyx tube; anthers as long as or or slightly exceeding the tips of the calyx teeth; ovary globose; style 1–1.5 mm long, persistent; stigma exserted. Capsules globose, 1–1.5 mm diam., included within the calyx tube, opening by 3 valves. Seeds subovoid, ca 0.5 mm long.

description: Herbs, amphibious, annual, erect or decumbent and rooting at the lower nodes, usually branched; flowering stems 4–40(–80) cm tall, weakly 4-angled or terete. Leaves decussate, (sub)sessile; lamina obovate or subspathulate-oblong, or narrowly oblong, 4–20 mm long, cuneate (or obtuse or somewhat cordate) at base, acute or obtuse at apex, margin cartilaginous (distinct in dried leaves). Bracts leaf-like or on spike-like lateral inflorescences smaller than foliage leaves, lanceolate; bracteoles linear, 1–2 mm long, about as long as the calyx tube. Flowers (sub)sessile, solitary in axils of bracts, either on main axis or on short, spike-like, lateral inflorescences; calyx tube campanulate, angled on the nerves, 1.5–2.5 mm long; calyx lobes 4, (acutely)triangular, 0.5–1.5 mm long, with cartilaginous margin; calyx appendages absent; petals 4, pinkish or white, persistent, linear or narrowly ovate, less than half as long as the calyx lobes; stamens 4, inserted about half-way up the calyx tube; anthers appearing just above the calyx lobe sinuses; ovary ellipsoid, ca 1.5 mm long; style 0.5–1 mm long, persistent in fruit; stigma level with or above the calyx lobes. Capsules red, ellipsoid, ca 2 mm long, opening by 2 valves. Seeds almost half-globose, 0.3–0.4 mm long.

description: Terrestrial (or aquatic or amphibious) annual herbs to10 cm tall, stem (branched or) simple, ascending or erect, often turf-forming. Leaves decussate or in whorls of 3–8, sessile; lamina linear (submerged leaves linear), 10 mm long or less. Bracts linear or (sub)ovate; bracteoles linear, about as long as the calyx tube. Flowers sessile, solitary; calyx tube pinkish, subglobose, 0.5–0.8 mm long; calyx lobes 3–5, but usually 4, broadly triangular, 0.25–0.5 mm long, calyx appendages or interjected folds absent; petals absent; stamens 1–4, usually included within the calyx tube; ovary globose; style very short, rarely to 0.3 mm long; stigma capitate. Capsules purplish, globose, 0.5–0.8 mm diam., opening by 3 valves. Seeds half-ovoid, ca 0.3 mm long.

description: Terrestrial (or amphibious) annual herbs 5–25 cm tall, stem procumbent at base, or erect, rooting at base, simple or branched mostly from lower part. Leaves decussate, sessile; lamina linear-lanceolate to ovate, 5–15 by 1–4 mm, at base obtuse or cuneate, apex obtuse or acute. Bracts resembling foliage leaves, obtuse at base, smaller than foliage leaves but always longer than the flowers; bracteoles linear, 0.5–1 mm long, not exceeding the calyx tube. Flowers solitary, sessile; calyx tube campanulate, becoming semi-globose in fruit; calyx lobes (4 or) 5, short triangular, ca 0.3 mm long; calyx appendages subulate, spreading in bud, about as long as the calyx lobes, rarely rudimentary or absent; petals (4 or) 5, rarely rudimentary, not persisting in fruit, ca 0.3 mm long; stamens (4 or) 5; filaments inserted below the middle of the calyx tube; anthers included, borne level with the apex of the calyx tube; ovary globose; style short, absent or to 0.3 mm long; stigma capitate. Capsules globose, ca 2 times as long as the calyx tube, to 2 mm diam., usually red in upper part, opening by 3 valves. Seeds half-ovoid, ca 0.3 mm long, straw-coloured.

description: Amphibious perennial herbs, stem ± succulent, green or red, at base decumbent, creeping or floating, or tufted, branched, to 40 cm tall, 4(–6)-angled towards the apex. Leaves decussate, sessile or short petiolate; lamina obovate to orbicular, to 2 cm long, 2.5 cm wide (submerged leaves linear to orbicular), red or purple on lower surface, nerves distinct, pinnate, green, white or red. Bracts ovate, 1–4 mm long; bracteoles linear to lanceolate, ca 1 mm long, about as long as calyx tube, membranous. Flowers subsessile, solitary in axils of bracts; inflorescence usually a terminal many-flowered pedunculate raceme, dense at early anthesis, elongate, lax (stem visible between the nodes) in fruit; calyx green or purplish, calyx tube campanulate ca 1 mm long, membranous, with 4 rib-like nerves; calyx lobes triangular, to 1 mm long; calyx appendages or folds absent; petals pink, 4, obovate, 2 to 3 times as long as calyx lobes; stamens 4; filaments inserted near base of calyx tube, ca 1.5 mm long, anthers level with middle of calyx lobes; ovary globose; style to 0.5 mm long; stigma peltate, ca 0.3 mm diam., level with anthers. Capsules globose, ca 1.5 mm diam., opening by 4 valves. Seeds half-ellipsoid, ca 0.5 mm long.

description: Herbs, aquatic or amphibious, subperennial. Stem floating or creeping, rooting and branched in basal part, or erect, little branched or unbranched, to 30 cm tall (long). Leaves in whorls of 4 or more; submerged leaves linear or capillary, thin, translucent, tinged with red, to 2 cm long, at apex ± bifid; aerial leaves usually in whorls of 3–12 (less than submersed leaves), rarely decussate, linear or oblong, rarely more than 5 mm long, apex obtuse or bifid. Bracts like aerial leaves, 1.5–3 mm long; bracteoles linear, to 0.5 mm long. Flowers in apical part of plant, in a loose inflorescence, the flowers emersed, solitary, several at each node; pedicel adnate to bract, to 1 mm long; calyx tube campanulate, membranous, translucent, ca 1.5 mm long; calyx lobes 4, triangular, ca 0.5 mm long; petals 4, obovate, showy, pink, ca 2.5 mm long; stamens 4, inserted below the middle of the calyx tube; anthers borne level with the top of the calyx lobes; nectar scales 2-lobed; ovary globose; style ca 0.5 mm long; stigma capitate. Capsules (immature, see Cook 1979) globose, ca 1 mm diam., opening by 2 valves. Seeds subovoid, ca 0.7 mm long.

description: Submerged herbs. Leaves submerged, alternate, linear, base loosely sheathed, 5–10 cm long, apex acute, entire but minutely toothed toward the apex. Inflorescence a short terminal spike at anthesis, appearing umbel-like in fruit. Flowers in pairs on slender peduncles which are short at first and surrounded by the sheath-like base of the subtending leaf; remaining short at anthesis; perianth vestigial or absent; stamens 2, upper and lower, the anthers attached to the peduncle at the back; carpels 4. Fruits 4; nutlets becoming stalked at maturity; borne on a spike, ovate, beaked.

description: Small trees or shrubs; branchlets pubescent, glabrescent. Leaves spiral, tufted at the ends of branchlets; lamina subcoriaceous, obovate; apex obtuse; base narrowly cuneate, glabrous; venation arched, somewhat looped; midrib raised above, rounded below; secondary veins variable in number; tertiary veins reticulately connected; stipules present. Flowers bisexual; pedicels pubescent. Calyx a single whorl of 5 free or partly united quincuncial sepals. Corolla glabrous; lobes exceeding the corolla tube. Stamens very short, included; staminodes 5. Ovary subglobose; style included. Fruits 1-seeded.</br></br>A genus with about 28 species in tropical Africa. One introduced species in Thailand.

description: Shrub or small tree ca 2 m tall; branchlets slender, glabrous, brownish. Leaves mostly spirally tufted at the ends of branchlets, young leaves purplish; lamina subcoriaceous, obovate, 7.5–10.5 by 2.5–4.5 cm, apex obtuse, base cuneate; both surfaces glabrous; secondary veins 13–15 on each side; petioles 2–3 mm long. Flowers few in clusters; pedicels 0.3–0.5 mm long, cernuous, ferrugineo-pilose. Calyx ferrugineo-tomentose, with 5 oblong-obtuse segments. Corolla whitish, slightly longer than calyx, deeply 5-fid. Stamens 5, filaments very short; anthers oblong, included; staminodes setaceous, as long as stamens. Ovary subglobose; style reaching the top of the corolla. Fruit 1.2–1.5 by 0.5–0.6 cm, glabrous, succulent, 1-seeded. Seed the same shape as the fruit, with a fragile brown glossy pericarp.

description: Aquatic, (sub)annual herbs, rarely branched, the upper leaves forming a floating rosette. Adventitious roots 2 emerging from either side of submersed leaf-scars, thread-like with numerous rectangular outgrowths, containing chlorophyll. Leaves alternate; petiole swollen about or above the middle; stipules small, divided to the base; lamina of floating leaves glabrous above, sparingly or densely hairy beneath, rhombic or deltoid, toothed in upper part. Flowers solitary from upper leaf axils, pedicellate, hermaphrodite, 4-merous; sepals, free, not imbricate; petals pale purplish or white; stamens episepalous, perigynous; ovary half inferior, bilocular, ovules 1 per locule, pendulous from apex; style about as long as calyx and stamens; disc lobed. Fruits drupaceous, 1-seeded; pericarp thin, decaying; endocarp (seeds) hard, variably 2–4-horned, horns usually barbellate at apex; cotyledons strongly unequal in size. Seed as the fruit.</br></br>Two species in Europe, Asia, and Africa; naturalised in America and in Australia.

description: Floating herbs, stem 1–2.5 mm diam. Leaves: petiole 5–15 cm long, slightly swollen above the middle; lamina glossy, glabrous and dark green above, somewhat hairy on veins and green or purplish below, often black-brown or with 2 dark spots at base, rhombic or triangular, 1.5–3 by 2–4 cm, base broadly cunate, margin in upper part coarsely and sharply incised. Flowers: petals pink, pale purplish or white, 5–7 mm long. Fruits narrowly rhomboid, 8–15 by 12–20 by 7–10 mm, 4-horned, lower horns descending, surface smooth or variously ribbed, horns conical, unequal in length, 10–15 mm long.

description: (Shrubs to) usually small trees. Stipules very early caducous, triangular. Leaves imparipinnate, but simple when young, unifoliolate to 4-jugate; petiole basally sometimes slightly constricted when dry, round to apically flattened or slightly channelled, rachis slightly reniform throughout, with usually 2 papillate teeth at every node, sometimes worn down to bumps; leaflets opposite; petiolules reniform, subapically with or without 2 papillate teeth, blade slightly asymmetric (except terminal leaflet), acroscopic side larger than basiscopic side, margin flat, serrate, teeth glandular, pointing upwards, tip of apex very blunt to rounded, both surfaces glabrous, upper surface dark green, lower surface (light) green; venation slightly raised on both sides, tertiary (secondary in non-compound leaves) veins looped and closed near margin, higher order veinlets reticulate. Inflorescences terminal and axillary panicles (Thailand), cymose, branches angular to somewhat grooved, somewhat flattened at nodes, glabrous or with papillae-like hairs, glabrescent; bracts gradually becoming smaller towards smaller branches and flowers, ovate to triangular, ciliate along margins. Flowers scented; pedicel round, with a subbasal abscission zone; sepals 5, imbricate, margin usually papillate, apex rounded to truncate, 2 outer smaller; petals 5, glabrous, apex rounded to truncate, rather translucent and membranous; stamens 5, filaments strap-like, basally broadened, touching each other, bent inwards, apically narrow, anthers dorsifixed, 2-thecate, introrse, opening by lengthwise slits, connective with or without convex apical knob; disc an upright annular ring, upper margin erose, 5-lobed; ovaries 3 (or 4), basally connate, each locule subovoid, glabrous, with 2 or 4‒6 ovules each, styles slender, stigmas connate, together knob-like, shortly papillate. Fruits drupaceous, with a variable number of ovules developed into seeds, short remnants of styles often sticking out from sides, smooth to warty; wall woody when dry, thin to very thick. Seeds ± triangular in transverse section, convex on outside, smooth, shiny; hilum apical, small, triangular.</br></br>Turpinia has 30‒40 species and in Asia it ranges from India and Sri Lanka to S China and Japan, throughout SE Asia and Malesia to New Guinea. It is also present in the tropical regions of S. America and the West Indies (type). Four species are present in Thailand.

description: (Shrubs to) trees, to 20 m tall, to 20 cm dbh; flowering branches 1.5‒4.5 mm diam. Outer bark rough to cracked and flaking, brownish to grey to blackish grey; inner bark brown. Stipules very early caducous, triangular, 1.5‒3 by 1.5‒3 mm, outside with very few and short hairs, glabrescent? Leaves (1- or) 2- or 3-jugate; petiole 2.5‒10.2 cm long; rachis 1‒17 cm long; petiolules 2‒21 mm long; subapically with 2 papillate teeth; blade (ovate to) elliptic to oblong (to slightly obovate), 3.5‒18.7 by 1.4‒6.6 cm, 2‒3.6 times as long as wide, papery to (sub)coriaceous, base cuneate to rounded, marginal teeth pointing upwards, 1.5‒9 mm apart (measured in middle of leaflet), apex acuminate to cuspidate; tertiary veins 8‒14 per side. Inflorescences to 29 cm long, rachis 0.7‒3.5 mm diam. At 2 cm from base, green; longest side branches to 12 cm long, branches with papillae-like hairs in grooves, especially near nodes, glabrescent. Flowers 2‒2.5 by 2.5‒4 mm; pedicel 1‒3.7 mm long, glabrous; sepals ovate to obovate, 1.3‒2 by 0.9‒1.6 mm, light green to light yellow; petals elliptic to obovate, 1.5‒2 by 0.8‒1.3 mm, white to light yellow; stamens: filaments 0.9‒1.5 mm long, white to light yellow, anthers 0.3‒0.5 by 0.3‒0.5 mm, light yellow, connective with convex apical knob; disc light yellow; ovaries 3, subovoid, 0.5‒0.8 by 0.5‒0.8 mm, green, carpels with 4 ovules per locule in 2 pairs, styles 0.5‒1 mm long, green, stigmas white. Fruits irregularly subglobular to flattened globular, 5‒11(‒20) mm diam., short remnants of styles sticking out from sides, otherwise smooth (central Thailand) to somewhat warty (northern Thailand), becoming yellow or blackish red; wall thin, < 2 mm thick. Seeds 3.2‒3.5 mm high by 4.4‒5 mm wide to 2.3‒3.5 mm thick.

description: Trees, to 10 m tall, to 33 cm dbh; flowering branches 1.5‒6.5 mm diam. Bark thin to slightly thickened, vertically ridged to vertically roughly cracked, light brown (to grey). Stipules unknown. Leaves (1- or) 2‒4-jugate; petiole 2.5‒7.3 cm long; rachis (2.3‒)5.5‒17.3 cm long; petiolules 2‒10 mm long, subapically with 2 papillae, blade ovate (to elliptic), 4‒10 by 1.5‒3.9 cm, 2.5‒2.7 times as long as wide, usually papery to subcoriaceous, base broadly cuneate to attenuate, marginal teeth pointing upwards, 1.9‒4 mm apart (measured in middle of leaflet), apex cuspidate to caudate; tertiary veins 8‒11 per side. Inflorescences to 25 cm long, rachis 0.7‒1.5 mm diam. at 2 cm from base; longest side branches to 9.5 cm long, green, branches glabrous. Flowers 2‒2.2 by 2.2‒3 mm; pedicel 1.5‒3 mm long, dull light yellow; sepals ovate to elliptic, 1.2‒1.8 by 1‒1.2 mm, imbricate, dull light yellow; petals elliptic, 1.2‒1.3 by 0.8‒1 mm, pale light yellowish with white margins; stamens: filaments 1.2‒1.3 mm long, light yellow, anthers 0.3‒0.4 by 0.3‒0.4 mm, light yellow, connective with convex apical knob; disc light yellow; ovaries 3(4), subovoid, c. 0.5‒0.7 by 0.5‒0.7 mm, carpels with 2 ovules next to each other, styles 0.6‒0.8 mm long, whitish, stigmas whitish. Fruits irregularly subglobular to flattened globular, 5‒7.3 by 6‒12 mm, short remnants of styles sticking out from sides, changing from light green to glossy dark red to blackish with purple juice; wall thin, < 2 mm thick. Seeds 4.3‒4.7 mm high by 3‒4.5 mm wide by 2.5‒3 mm thick.

description: ((Under)shrubs to) trees, to 23 m tall, to 38 cm dbh; flowering branches 3‒5 mm diam. Outer bark cream to light grey to pale brown, smooth to rugged; inner brownish pale yellow-brown to pink to red; sapwood brownish; heartwood yellow. Stipules unknown. Leaves (unifoliolate to) 1‒3-jugate; petioles 5.6‒13.6 cm long, rachis 5.2‒19.5 cm long; petiolules 1.5‒10 mm long, subapically without (to sometimes with vestiges of 2) papillae-like teeth; blade ovate to oblong, 6‒30.5 by 2.6‒14.8 cm, 1.7‒2.9 times as long as wide, coriaceous, base cuneate to generally attenuate, marginal teeth pointing upwards to somewhat inwards, 4.5‒9 mm apart (measured in middle of leaflet), apex acuminate to caudate; tertiary veins 7‒13 per side. Inflorescences to 26 cm long, green, rachis 2‒3 mm diam. at 2 cm from base, peduncle 3‒7.5 cm long, round, longest side branches to 7 cm long, branches with very short papillae-like hairs in grooves, especially near nodes, glabrescent. Flowers 4‒7.5 by 5‒9 mm; pedicel 2.2‒6.5 mm long, glabrous; sepals: 2 outer 1.8‒3.4 by 2.2‒3.2 mm, these and a third ovate, others obovate, 3.8‒5.5 by 2‒4 mm, pale green with a dark red-purple streak in bud, turning tan-greenish to uniform dark red-purple with age, very stiff, drying dark brown; petals oblong, 2.2‒5 by 1.5‒3 mm, cream to pale orange tinged red-purple to tan-orange; stamens: filaments 3‒3.3 mm long, translucent to tan-orange, anthers 1.2‒1.5 by 0.8‒1 mm, bright yellow to tan-orange, connective without convex apical knob; disc pale yellow to tan-orange; ovaries 3 (or 4), subovoid, 1‒1.2 mm by c. 1 mm, red, carpels with 4 ovules each, in 2 pairs, styles 1.4‒1.8 mm long, red. Fruits irregularly subglobular to obpyramidal, when young horned with remnants of styles, still visible when older, 15‒28 by 15‒34 mm, yellow to yellow-orange, wall very woody, 2‒6 mm thick, smooth, usually with three dehiscence lines visible, these not present in wall itself (indehiscent). Seeds c. 8.5 mm high by 7.3 mm wide to 4.5 mm thick.

description: Annual or perennial herbs, erect or ascending, glabrous or hairy. Leaves alternate, rarely opposite, sometimes rosulate, usually sessile. Flowers regular, mostly blue, small or medium-sized, terminal or axillary, or in (few-flowered) thyrses or panicles; pedicel short or long, bracteoles absent; calyx lobes mostly 5, persistent; corolla campanulate or funnel-shaped, lobed to various depth; stamens 5, alternating with corolla lobes, free, anthers coherent, narrow; filaments often broadened at base, ciliate, the apical part often recurved; ovary inferior (or superior, not in Thailand), 2- or 3- (or 5)-celled, style about as long as (or longer than) corolla, stigma 2- or 3- (or 5)-lobed. Fruit a capsule, commonly with (2 or) 3 valves at apex. Seeds numerous (or few), ellipsoid or triangular, 0.5–1 mm long.</br></br>A genus of about 250 species distributed mainly in the southern hemisphere, in northern South America, western Europe, southern Africa, southern and eastern Asia, and especially Australia. Two species in Thailand.

description:
Delicate, erect annual, 10–20 cm tall including inflorescences, sparsely hairy; stem single. Leaves: petiole 0.1–0.3 cm long; blade elliptic, 1–3 by 0.4–1 cm, margin faintly crenate. Inflorescences broad panicles, about as long as the vegetative part of the plant, nearly glabrous; bracts 0.1–0.2(–0.4) cm long. Flowers: pedicel 10–30 mm long; sepals 
subglabrous, long-triangular, ca 1 mm long; corolla pale blue, 5-partite, lobes 2(–3) by ca 0.4 mm; filaments narrow, ca 1 mm long, anthers ca 0.4 by 0.1 mm; ovary ca 1 mm diam., at apex conical, style ca 1.5 mm long, stigmatic lobes 3, short. Capsule subglobose, ca 2 mm diam., 2-valved. Seeds numerous, brown, shining, triangular, ca 0.5 mm long.

description:
Annual, erect or subannual or (sub)perennial ascending herb, 3–50 cm tall including inflorescences, glabrous or hairy, sometimes hairy only in the lower part; stem solitary and erect or stems several and diffuse. Leaves sessile; blade glabrous above, scabrid(-hairy) below, elliptic to linear, lower ones sometimes spatulate, 3–5.5 by 0.2–0.6 cm, margin entire 
or serrulate, apex acute. Inflorescences loose panicle-like racemes comprising half the length of the plant or more, one- to few-flowered, bracts small. Flowers: pedicel 10–20 cm long; calyx lobes (3–)5, lanceolate, 1–4 mm long; corolla pale blue, tube 1–4(–5) mm long, lobes (3–)5, (sub)elliptic, 1–5 mm long, acute(–acuminate); filaments about as long as anthers, at base rhomboid, abruptly narrowed at apex, anthers 0.5–2.5 mm long; ovary obconical, 1–5 mm long, style 1.5–5 mm long, stigma 2- or 3-lobed. Capsule 2- or 3-valved, obconical, 1.5–8(–12) mm long. Seeds ellipsoid.

description: Shrubs or small trees, irregularly branching. Leaves opposite (decussate), (sub)sessile, whitish short hairy, lower surface glandular punctate; stipules absent (some hairs present only). Inflorescences condensed axillary of leaves or fallen leaves, (branched) racemes to 3 cm long, bracts minute. Flowers 5- or 6-merous, slightly zygomorphic; bracteoles 2, minute; calyx tube elongate, slightly constricted at level of stamen insertion; sepals short, alternating at sinus with minute epicalyx processes; petals red, small, persistent; stamens 12, in two whorls, alternating in length, inserted deeply in the tube; ovary ellipsoid, (sub)sessile, nearly 2-locular; style thicker and longer than staminal filaments, ultimately long exserted together with the stamens and curved towards one side; stigma punctiform; placenta appearing central. Capsules thin-walled, translucent at maturity, irregularly (or loculicidally) dehiscent. Seeds many, narrowly obpyramidal, small.</br></br>Two species, one in Africa and the Arabian Peninsula, one species in Madagascar and SE Asia.

description: Shrubs 1–5 m tall, stems and branches elongate, bark whitish, membranous-flaky, young twigs pubescent, glabrescent. Leaves: petiole ca 1 mm long; lamina sparsely or densely hairy above, subglabrous or, especially on nerves, short-hairy beneath, blackish glandular punctate beneath, lanceolate or ovate-lanceolate, 3–14 by 0.5–4 cm, base rounded or subcordate, apex long acuminate. Inflorescences with 2–15 flowers, pedicels short. Flowers: calyx tube (orange-)red, greenish towards base, 9–15 mm long; sepals oblong-ovate or triangular, 2–3 mm long, epicalyx appendages minute; petals 6, lanceolate, long acuminate, 2(–5) mm, about as long as the sepals; stamens 12, somewhat unequal in length, inserted above the base of the ovary, long exserted towards one side. Capsules ellipsoid, 5–10 mm long, sometimes lacerating the calyx. Seeds reddish brown, 1–1.5 mm long.

description: Trees; branchlets terete, angular or compressed, pubescent or glabrescent. Leaves spirally arranged or tufted on short shoots; lamina chartaceous or coriaceous, elliptic-obovate or rhomboid; apex obtuse or acute; base cuneate; venation looped or arched; midrib grooved, raised or flat above; secondary veins variable in number; tertiary venation reticulate; stipules absent. Flowers bisexual, axillary, fasciculate or clustered along short leafless shoots. Calyx a single whorl of 5 lobes, free, quincuncial. Corolla with short tube and spreading lobes; tube shorter than or equalling lobes, hairy around the base of the filaments, glabrous outside; lobes 5, simple, imbricate. Stamens 5, inserted at the top of the corolla tube and exserted; anthers sagittate, apiculate, extrorse, glabrous. Staminodes 5, petaloid, glabrous, apex aristate or filiform, margin entire, serrate or fimbriate-tomentose. Disc absent. Ovary (4–) 5-locular; style long. Fruits 1–3-seeded, berry. Seed laterally compressed.</br></br>About 15 species in tropical Asia. Three species in Thailand.

description: Tree to 13 m tall; branchlets terete or compressed, sparsely pubescent, glabrescent, somewhat spiny; lenticels elliptic, conspicuous. Leaves scattered; lamina chartaceous or coriaceous, narrowly to broadly elliptic or obovate, 6–14.5 by 2.5–6.5 cm; apex acute to obtusely acute or obtuse; base cuneate, glabrous; young leaves sparsely pubescent, glabrescent; midrib flat or raised, crested above, densely or sparsely pubescent on both surfaces; secondary veins 11–16 on each side; petioles (0.5–) 1.2–2 cm long, whitish tomentose, glabrescent. Flowers axillary, in 2–5-flowered fascicles; pedicels 6.8–10 mm long, tomentose. Sepals , two exterior ovate, 5–5.8 by 2.7–3 mm, whitish tomentose outside, reddish brown sericeous inside except for a glabrous base; two interior sepals narrowly ovate or lanceolate, 5.3–6.9 by 2.3–3.5 mm, with membranous margin, reddish brown sericeous on both surfaces except for a glabrous base inside; the fifth sepal narrowly to broadly ovate 5.6–6.5 by 2.3–3.3 mm, the margin, which is covered by one exterior sepal, membranous, reddish brown sericeous on both surfaces except for a glabrous base inside. Corolla tube 1.8–2.3 mm long; lobes lanceolate or oblong, 4.7–5.5 by 1.2–2.5 mm, glabrous, rarely tomentose at margin base. Stamens 4.5–5.5 mm long; filaments filiform, 1.2–2.2 mm long; anthers 3–3.5 mm long; connective 0.3–0.6 mm long; staminodes oblong or ovate, 3.1–4.5 by 1.2–2.3 mm, concave, glabrous with aristate apex and fimbriate-tomentose margin. Ovary 5-locular, 5-lobed, brownish hirsute; style 6–10.5 mm long, 5-ribbed, glabrous. Fruits ovoid-ellipsoid, 2–4 by 2–2.5 cm, 1–2-seeded. Seed compressed ellipsoid, brownish.

description: Tree to 10 m tall; branchlets terete, tomentose or glabrescent, sometimes spiny. Leaves scattered; lamina chartaceous or subcoriaceous, obovate, 6.5–12 by 3.5–6.5 cm; apex obtuse or broadly acute; base attenuate or narrowly cuneate, decurrent; upper surface sparsely tomentose, glabrescent; lower surface densely tomentose below or both surfaces glabrous; midrib raised above, rounded and prominent below, pubescent on both surfaces; secondary veins 8–13 on each side, looped; tertiary veins conspicuous above, inconspicuous below; petioles 5–10 cm long, whitish or yellowish puberulous or glabrescent, flat or raised above. Flowers axillary, in 3–7-flowered fascicles; pedicels 3.7–10 mm long, tomentose. Sepals two exterior ovate, 3.5–5.5 by 1.8–3 mm, sericeous except for a glabrous lower part inside; two interior sepals lanceolate, 3.1–5.6 by 1–2.2 mm, somewhat crested, with membranous margin, sericeous except for a glabrous lower part inside; the fifth sepal narrowly ovate 3–5.2 by 2.6–2.7 mm, the margin which is covered by one exterior sepal, membranous. Corolla tube 0.6–2.2 mm long; lobes lanceolate or oblong, 2.3–5 by 0.8–1.3 mm. Stamens 3–3.5 mm long; filaments subulate, 1.7–2.3 mm long; anthers 1.8–2.4 mm long; connective 0.2–0.9 mm long; staminodes lanceolate, ovate or spathulate, 3–3.8 by 0.5–1 mm, glabrous with filiform apex and serrate, entire or undulate margin. Ovary 5-locular, yellowish hirsute; style filiform, 8.5–9 mm long, 5-ribbed, glabrous. Fruits ellipsoid, 3.5–4 by 2–2.5 cm, 1–3-seeded. Seed brown, ca 2 by 1 cm.

description: Tree ca 12 m tall; branchlets terete or angular, striate, glabrous. Leaves fascicled on short shoots; lamina coriaceous, spathulate or elliptic, somewhat rhomboid or oblong, 2–4.5 by (0.6–) 1–2 cm; apex obtuse or mucronate; base cuneate; both surfaces glabrous; midrib raised, flat above; secondary veins 5–10 on each side, arched and joined; tertiary veins reticulate, but with one vein more distinct and parallel to the secondary veins; petioles 2–3 cm long, flat above, rounded below, glabrous. Flowers clustered on foliate brachyblasts; pedicels terete or angular, 3–4 mm long, whitish puberulous. Sepals ovate or lanceolate, 2.3–4 by 1–1.5 mm, greyish puberulous tomentose on both surfaces, inner sepals with membranous margin. Corolla tube 1–1.5 mm long; lobes lanceolate, 3–3.5 by 1–1.5 mm. Stamens 3–3.5 mm long; filaments subulate, 1.5–2 mm long; anthers 2–2.3 mm long; connective 0.1–0.2 mm long; staminodes lanceolate-aristate, 2–3 mm long, margin entire. Ovary 4–5-locular, yellowish-whitish hirsute; style 3–4 mm long, hirsute at base. Fruits unknown.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
